method: Parquet footers and filesystem metadata for table inventories, plus the first rows of each table for one example value per column; small provenance JSON and run logs for provenance. No table is scanned in full and no large raw input is read.
count_unit: Stored rows across derived tables; not unique documents.

schema.name: work_id
schema.description: OpenAlex work id ('W' + digits, URL prefix stripped); the same values as paper_id in the sibling tables, under a different column name. One row per work with at least one author id in works/authorships (292.4M works).

schema.name: author_list
schema.description: ';'-joined OpenAlex author ids (opaque 'A' + digits) in byline order (author_position_int, ties broken by author id), each author listed once even when the source repeats them per affiliation.

schema.name: team_size
schema.description: Number of distinct author ids on the work (= number of entries in author_list).

schema.name: first_author
schema.description: OpenAlex author id ('A' + digits) at the lowest author position (first entry of author_list).

schema.name: last_author
schema.description: OpenAlex author id at the highest author position (last entry of author_list); equals first_author for single-author works.

files.grain: One work_id with ordered, deduplicated author IDs and team_size.

schema.name: paper_id
schema.description: OpenAlex work id as a string: 'W' followed by digits (e.g. W3002427681), URL prefix stripped; joins every other OpenAlex/output table. Same 292.4M works as paper_author (which calls the column work_id).

schema.name: team_size
schema.description: Number of distinct authors (author ids) on the work; identical to paper_author.team_size on every row.

schema.name: n_located
schema.description: Number of the work's authors with at least one country code (OpenAlex's per-authorship 'countries', i.e. the countries of the institutions their affiliations were matched to). 0 when no author is located.

schema.name: countries
schema.description: Sorted, ';'-joined distinct ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes over all located authors (e.g. 'CN;US'); null when no author is located (53.5% of works). Namibia is 'NA', not a missing value. Coverage rises strongly over time, so take shares over located works.

schema.name: n_countries
schema.description: Number of distinct codes in countries; 0 when countries is null.

schema.name: country_author_counts
schema.description: Located authors per country as 'CC:n' items joined by ';', ordered by count descending then code (e.g. 'US:3;CN:1'). An author with two countries counts in both, so the counts can sum to more than n_located; null when no author is located.

schema.name: first_author_country
schema.description: ';'-joined sorted country codes of the first author (lowest author_position_int, ties by numeric author id); can hold several codes. Null when that author has no country (not replaced by the next located author).

schema.name: last_author_country
schema.description: ';'-joined sorted country codes of the last author (highest author_position_int); null when that author has no country.

schema.name: is_international
schema.description: True when the work's authors span more than one country (n_countries > 1).

files.grain: One work with the ISO2 countries of its authors' institutions: the sorted distinct set, the per-country author counts, and the first and last author's own countries.

schema.name: paper_id
schema.description: OpenAlex work id as a string: 'W' followed by digits (e.g. W3002427681), URL prefix stripped; joins every other OpenAlex/output table. One row per work with a usable publication year (460.5M), cited or not.

schema.name: C_3
schema.description: Number of citations received within 3 years of publication, publication year counted as year 0: incoming reference edges from OpenAlex works with 0 <= citing year - cited year <= 3 (calendar years), over the OpenAlex works/referenced_works graph (2026-09-23 release), edges kept when both ends have a publication year in 1000-2030. 0 for uncited documents; cohorts less than 3 years before the snapshot are right-truncated.

schema.name: C_5
schema.description: Number of citations received within 5 years of publication, publication year counted as year 0: incoming reference edges from OpenAlex works with 0 <= citing year - cited year <= 5 (calendar years), over the OpenAlex works/referenced_works graph (2026-09-23 release), edges kept when both ends have a publication year in 1000-2030. 0 for uncited documents; cohorts less than 5 years before the snapshot are right-truncated.

schema.name: C_10
schema.description: Number of citations received within 10 years of publication, publication year counted as year 0: incoming reference edges from OpenAlex works with 0 <= citing year - cited year <= 10 (calendar years), over the OpenAlex works/referenced_works graph (2026-09-23 release), edges kept when both ends have a publication year in 1000-2030. 0 for uncited documents; cohorts less than 10 years before the snapshot are right-truncated.

schema.name: C_all
schema.description: Number of citations received from works published in or after the focal year (citing year - cited year >= 0, no upper bound), over the OpenAlex works/referenced_works graph (2026-09-23 release), edges kept when both ends have a publication year in 1000-2030. Citations from works dated earlier than the focal document are dropped. 0 for uncited documents.

schema.name: paper_id
schema.description: OpenAlex work id as a string: 'W' followed by digits (e.g. W3002427681), URL prefix stripped; joins every other OpenAlex/output table. Identifies the cited paper. Sparse panel: one row per (paper, citing year) with at least one citation of any channel; a missing year means zero, a never-cited paper is absent.

schema.name: pub_year
schema.description: Publication year of the cited paper as dated in the citation graph (OpenAlex publication_year, kept when within 1000-2030; a few implausible pre-1800 years remain).

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: Calendar year of the row's citations: the citing work's publication year for p2p, the citing patent's grant year (PatentsView g_patent patent_date) for pat2p_*. Rows with cite_year < pub_year are dropped; 2026 is a partial year.

schema.name: yrs_since_pub
schema.description: cite_year - pub_year in years (>= 0; 0 = the publication year).

schema.name: p2p
schema.description: Number of OpenAlex works published in cite_year that cite this paper (incoming reference edges of the OpenAlex graph); 0 on rows that exist only for a patent citation.

schema.name: pat2p_examiner
schema.description: Number of US patent-to-paper citations (Reliance on Science / PCS links) whose reftype is 'exm' (examiner-added), dated by the citing patent's grant year. Effectively empty: only a few hundred such citations exist in the whole file, so use the sum of the two pat2p columns as total patent citations.

schema.name: pat2p_non_examiner
schema.description: Number of US patent-to-paper citations (Reliance on Science / PCS links) of any other reftype (overwhelmingly applicant 'app'), dated by grant year; only links whose patent number matches a PatentsView grant are counted, no confidence-score floor.

files.grain: One document per citing year.

schema.name: CD_3
schema.description: Funk & Owen-Smith CD (disruption) index for window '3': (ni - nj) / (ni + nj + nk), counting only papers with 0 <= year(citer) - year(focal) <= 3, publication year counted as year 0. Nominal range [-1, 1] (+1 disruptive, -1 consolidating). Null when the paper has no citers at all, or when neither a citer nor a paper citing its references falls in the window; 0 (not null) when the window has no citer but has papers citing the focal references. Self-citation edges are dropped from the graph, so CD stays within [-1, 1].

schema.name: F_3
schema.description: Foundation share (0-1) for window '3': fraction of the focal paper's in-window citers whose own references include more of the focal paper's other in-window citers than of its references (down > up); ties with up = down > 0 count 1/2 here and 1/2 in E. F + E + G = 1. Null when the window has no citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3
schema.description: Extension share (0-1) for window '3': fraction of in-window citers that cite more of the focal paper's references than of its other in-window citers (up > down), plus half of the ties. Null when the window has no citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3
schema.description: Generalization share (0-1) for window '3': fraction of in-window citers that cite neither any of the focal paper's references nor any of its other in-window citers (up = down = 0). Null when the window has no citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3
schema.description: Count of citers in window '3' (0 <= year(citer) - year(focal) <= 3, publication year counted as year 0) that cite none of the focal paper's references. -1 is a sentinel: the paper has no citers at all, or the window holds neither a citer nor a paper citing its references.

schema.name: nj_3
schema.description: Count of citers in window '3' that also cite at least one of the focal paper's references. -1 sentinel as for ni.

schema.name: nk_3
schema.description: Count of papers (other than the focal one) published in window '3' (0 <= year(citer) - year(focal) <= 3, publication year counted as year 0) that cite at least one of the focal paper's references but not the focal paper itself. -1 sentinel as for ni. Self-citation edges are dropped from the graph, so -1 is only ever the sentinel.

schema.name: pctl_year

schema.name: pctl_group

schema.name: CD_3_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile (0-1] of CD_3 within its (pctl_year, pctl_group) cohort among papers with a non-null CD_3: rank() / n, ties share the lowest rank. Null when CD_3 or pctl_group is null. CD has large tie blocks (e.g. CD = 1), so use CD_3_pctl_cume for top-x% thresholds.

schema.name: year
schema.description: OpenAlex publication_year stored as float64 (null for 3.3% of works). Raw value, not range checked (1007-2050 in the file); the graph-based tables only keep works dated 1000-2030.

schema.name: doctype
schema.description: OpenAlex work type (article, other, dataset, book-chapter, dissertation, preprint, book, review, paratext, letter, report, editorial, erratum, retraction, ...); not the MAG or Dimensions vocabulary.

schema.name: ref_count
schema.description: Number of references the work lists in OpenAlex works/referenced_works (its rows in the referenced_works_w_year edge table), i.e. references to other OpenAlex works within this snapshot; 0 when none. Not comparable with SciSciNet or Dimensions counts.

schema.name: journal
schema.description: Display name (sources.csv.gz) of the work's primary-location source, or of its first location's source when there is no primary one. Any source type: journals, repositories, conferences, ebook platforms. Null when the work has no source (12.8%).
schema.example: WT Tijdschrift over de geschiedenis van de Vlaamse beweging

schema.name: is_journal
schema.description: True when that source's OpenAlex type is 'journal', False for other source types, null when the work has no source.

schema.name: author_list
schema.description: Always null (Arrow type null): placeholder kept for schema compatibility; author lists are in paper_author.parquet.

schema.name: FoS_0
schema.description: ';'-joined distinct OpenAlex field names (26 fields) of all the work's scored topics (up to 3, works/topics), ordered by topic score, best first; equals ';'.join(field). Null when the work has no topic (20.6%).

schema.name: FoS_rep
schema.description: OpenAlex field name of the work's highest-scoring topic (e.g. 'Materials Science'); the cohort key of paper_hit_probability. Null when no topic.

schema.name: domain
schema.description: OpenAlex domain (Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Physical Sciences or Social Sciences) of the work's highest-scoring topic; null when no topic. No Dimensions twin.

schema.name: primary_topic_field
schema.description: Field name of OpenAlex's own primary topic (works_semantic.primary_topic_json); null when the work has none. Equal to FoS_rep wherever both exist.

schema.name: primary_topic_subfield
schema.description: Subfield name (OpenAlex topic hierarchy, about 250 subfields) of the primary topic; null when none.

schema.name: primary_topic_topic
schema.description: Display name of the primary topic (about 4,500 OpenAlex topics), looked up in topics.csv.gz by topic id; null when none.

schema.name: field
schema.description: List of the distinct field names of all the work's scored topics (1-3), best topic score first; null (not an empty list) when the work has no topic.

schema.name: subfield
schema.description: List of the distinct subfield names of all the work's topics, best score first; de-duplicated by name (8 names are shared by two subfields and collapse to one entry); null when no topic.

schema.name: topic
schema.description: List of all the work's topic names, one per scored topic (1-3), best score first; topic[0] equals primary_topic_topic. Null when no topic. Topic ids and scores are in paper_topics.parquet.

schema.name: paper_id
schema.description: OpenAlex work id as a string: 'W' followed by digits (e.g. W3002427681), URL prefix stripped; joins every other OpenAlex/output table. Only documents with at least one dated citation (citing year >= publication year) appear; uncited documents are omitted.

schema.name: SB_B
schema.description: Ke et al. (2015) beauty coefficient B from the yearly citation histogram C[t] (t = citing year - publication year >= 0, all years up to the snapshot): sum over t = 0..t_m of ((c_m - c_0)/t_m * t + c_0 - C[t]) / max(C[t], 1), where t_m is the age of the first citation peak. 0 when the peak is in the publication year; can be negative; higher = longer dormancy before a burst. Unitless; unreliable for small n_cite.

schema.name: SB_T
schema.description: Awakening time: age in years since publication (not a calendar year), 0..t_m, at which the citation curve lies farthest from the straight line joining (0, C[0]) and the peak (t_m, C[t_m]). 0 when the paper peaks in its publication year.

schema.name: n_cite
schema.description: Number of dated citations the histogram was built from: citations from works published in or after the document's publication year, all years (>= 1).

schema.name: paper_id
schema.description: OpenAlex work id as a string: 'W' followed by digits (e.g. W3002427681), URL prefix stripped; joins every other OpenAlex/output table. Only journal-type works (primary-location source of OpenAlex type 'journal') published 1980-2020, with 2-1000 dated references in the graph and at least one scorable journal pair (46.4M); merged from the 18 year-range partitions, 1900-1979 never run.

schema.name: Z_median
schema.description: Median (numpy linear interpolation) of the Uzzi et al. (2013) z-scores of the distinct journal pairs formed by the journals of the paper's references (self-pairs included), each z taken from the paper's publication-year cohort (z_score_pair). Unitless; low or negative = atypical combinations, high = conventional.

schema.name: Z_10pct
schema.description: 10th percentile (numpy linear interpolation) of the same distinct-pair z-scores: the novelty tail (negative = the paper makes some combinations rarer than chance).

schema.name: Z_min
schema.description: Minimum z over the paper's distinct journal pairs (an addition to Uzzi et al.).

schema.name: n_pairs
schema.description: Number of distinct journal pairs among the paper's references that received a z (pairs whose null standard deviation is 0 are dropped); distinct pairs, not pair occurrences.

schema.name: SB_B
schema.description: Ke et al. (2015) beauty coefficient B from the yearly citation histogram C[t] (t = citing year - publication year >= 0, all years up to the snapshot): sum over t = 0..t_m of ((c_m - c_0)/t_m * t + c_0 - C[t]) / max(C[t], 1), where t_m is the age of the first citation peak. 0 when the peak is in the publication year; can be negative; higher = longer dormancy before a burst. Unitless; unreliable for small n_cite.

schema.name: SB_T
schema.description: Awakening time: age in years since publication (not a calendar year), 0..t_m, at which the citation curve lies farthest from the straight line joining (0, C[0]) and the peak (t_m, C[t_m]). 0 when the paper peaks in its publication year.

schema.name: n_cite
schema.description: Number of dated citations the histogram was built from: citations from works published in or after the document's publication year, all years (>= 1).

schema.description: USPTO patent number as a string, without 'US' prefix or kind code (7-8 digits, e.g. '10000000'; a few dozen 'RE...' ids that PatentsView types as utility). The cited patent; same 7,160,531 patents as patent_citation. Sparse: one row per (patent, citing year) with >= 1 citation, so a missing year means zero.

schema.name: grant_year
schema.description: Grant year of the cited patent P (calendar year of g_patent.patent_date), 1976-2025.

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: Grant year of the citing patents, used for both granted and pre-grant-publication citations (not the date the reference was made), 1976-2025.

schema.name: yrs_since_grant
schema.description: cite_year - grant_year in years (0-49); citations with a negative lag are dropped. Summing a count over yrs_since_grant <= w reproduces patent_citation's _w column.

schema.name: C
schema.description: Granted citations (g_us_patent_citation rows, third party dropped) received by P from patents granted in cite_year; per-year, not cumulative; = C_examiner + C_non_examiner + C_unknown.

schema.name: C_examiner
schema.description: Part of C with citation_category 'cited by examiner' (flag exists only for citers granted from ~2002).

schema.name: C_non_examiner
schema.description: Part of C with a non-empty category other than examiner/third party (applicant, other, imported from a related application).

schema.name: C_unknown
schema.description: Part of C with an empty citation_category: 100% of C for cite_year <= 2001, ~5% in 2002, 0 afterwards.

schema.name: appC
schema.description: Citations of P's pre-grant publication (pgpub mapped to P via pg_granted_pgpubs_crosswalk) made by patents granted in cite_year (g_us_application_citation, third party dropped); = appC_examiner + appC_non_examiner. Zero for every cite_year before 2005 in this build.

schema.name: appC_non_examiner

Utility patents granted 1976-2025 that appear in the granted citation graph (g_us_patent_citation, third-party rows not excluded) as citing or cited patent; never-cited patents have every metric null.

schema.name: CD_3
schema.description: CD index (ni_3 - nj_3) / (ni_3 + nj_3 + nk_3) in [-1, 1] (+1 disruptive) on the granted utility-to-utility citation network (duplicate pairs and self-citations removed), counting citers and nk patents with 0 <= y - y_P <= 3 on grant years. Null if P is never cited or the denominator is 0; 0 with ni = nj = 0 when no citer is in the window but nk > 0. Inflated for early grant years (pre-1976 references missing).

schema.name: F_3
schema.description: Foundation share: fraction of P's citers in the window (0 <= y - y_P <= 3 on grant years) that cite more of P's other in-window citers than of P's references (down > up); a tie with up = down > 0 adds 0.5 to F and E. F + E + G = 1; null when P has no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3
schema.description: Extension share: fraction of P's in-window citers that cite more of P's references than of P's other in-window citers (up > down), plus half of the up = down > 0 ties; null when no in-window citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3
schema.description: Generalization share: fraction of P's in-window citers that cite none of P's references and none of P's other in-window citers; null when no in-window citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3
schema.description: Number of patents citing P in the window (0 <= y - y_P <= 3 on grant years) that cite none of P's references. Stored as float; null where CD_3 is null.

schema.name: nj_3
schema.description: Number of patents citing P in the window that also cite at least one of P's references.

schema.name: nk_3
schema.description: Number of patents granted in the window (0 <= y - y_P <= 3 on grant years) that cite at least one of P's references but not P.

schema.description: CD index (ni_10 - nj_10) / (ni_10 + nj_10 + nk_10) in [-1, 1] (+1 disruptive) on the extended network (granted citations plus citations of pre-grant publications mapped to their granted patent, union de-duplicated), counting citers and nk patents with 0 <= y - y_P <= 10 on grant years. Null if P is never cited or the denominator is 0; 0 with ni = nj = 0 when no citer is in the window but nk > 0. Equals patent_disruption.CD_10 for grant years <= 1990 (verified).

schema.name: F_10
schema.description: Foundation share: fraction of P's citers in the window (0 <= y - y_P <= 10 on grant years) that cite more of P's other in-window citers than of P's references (down > up); a tie with up = down > 0 adds 0.5 to F and E. F + E + G = 1; null when P has no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_10
schema.description: Extension share: fraction of P's in-window citers that cite more of P's references than of P's other in-window citers (up > down), plus half of the up = down > 0 ties; null when no in-window citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_10
schema.description: Generalization share: fraction of P's in-window citers that cite none of P's references and none of P's other in-window citers; null when no in-window citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_10
schema.description: Number of patents citing P in the window (0 <= y - y_P <= 10 on grant years) that cite none of P's references. Stored as float; null where CD_10 is null.

schema.name: nj_10
schema.description: Number of patents citing P in the window that also cite at least one of P's references.

schema.name: nk_10
schema.description: Number of patents granted in the window (0 <= y - y_P <= 10 on grant years) that cite at least one of P's references but not P.

schema.name: CD_all

schema.name: n_base_rows
schema.description: Row count of patent_disruption.parquet (granted network) at run time, 8,062,166; the same on every row.

schema.name: n_app_rows
schema.description: Row count of patent_disruption_app.parquet (extended network), 8,460,168; the same on every row.

schema.name: n_app_only
schema.description: Patents present only in the extended table (reachable only via pre-grant-publication citations), 398,002; no patent is in the granted table only.

schema.name: n_paired
schema.description: Patents present in both tables with CD for this window non-null in both; every statistic below is over this set. Granted side = the pre-de-duplication build of patent_disruption (this ran 2026-09-02 before the dedup rebuild; base_mean matches the old file), which differs from the current one by < 1e-4 in mean CD.

schema.name: base_mean
schema.description: Mean CD_w of the paired patents in the granted network (patent_disruption). Granted side = the pre-de-duplication build of patent_disruption (this ran 2026-09-02 before the dedup rebuild; base_mean matches the old file), which differs from the current one by < 1e-4 in mean CD.

schema.name: app_mean
schema.description: Mean CD_w of the paired patents in the extended network (patent_disruption_app).

schema.name: delta
schema.description: Mean of (extended - granted) CD_w over paired patents = app_mean - base_mean; negative means counting pre-grant-publication citations makes patents look more consolidating.

schema.name: pearson
schema.description: Pearson correlation of CD_w, granted vs extended, over all paired patents.

schema.name: spearman
schema.description: Spearman rank correlation of CD_w, granted vs extended, estimated on a random sample of min(1,000,000, n_paired) paired patents (numpy seed 0).

schema.name: pct_down
schema.description: Percent (0-100) of paired patents whose CD_w is lower in the extended network.

schema.name: pct_up
schema.description: Percent (0-100) of paired patents whose CD_w is higher in the extended network.

schema.name: pct_same
schema.description: Percent (0-100) of paired patents whose CD_w is exactly equal in both networks.

schema.name: d_ni
schema.description: Mean over paired patents of (extended - granted) ni_w: added citers that cite none of P's references.

schema.name: d_nj
schema.description: Mean over paired patents of (extended - granted) nj_w: added citers that also cite P's references.

schema.name: d_nk
schema.description: Mean over paired patents of (extended - granted) nk_w: added patents citing P's references but not P.

schema.name: patent_id
schema.description: USPTO patent number as a string, without 'US' prefix or kind code (7-8 digits, e.g. '10000000'; a few dozen 'RE...' ids that PatentsView types as utility). Utility patents with >= 1 disambiguated inventor row (8,531,216 of 8,531,961).

schema.name: n_inventors
schema.description: Distinct PatentsView-disambiguated inventors on the patent (de-duplicated on inventor_id, lowest sequence kept); equals the number of ids in patent_metadata.inventor_list.

schema.name: n_located
schema.description: Inventors whose location_id on this patent resolves to a country in g_location_disambiguated (<= n_inventors).

schema.name: countries
schema.description: Distinct ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the located inventors, sorted and ';'-joined (e.g. 'DE;US'); the address printed on this grant, not the inventor's usual location. Null when no inventor is located. Namibia is 'NA'.

schema.name: n_countries
schema.description: Number of codes in countries; 0 when countries is null.

schema.name: country_inventor_counts
schema.description: Located inventors per country as 'CC:n' pairs, ';'-joined, ordered by count descending then code (e.g. 'US:3;JP:1'); counts sum to n_located; null when none is located.

schema.name: first_inventor_country
schema.description: ISO2 country of the first-listed (lowest inventor_sequence) inventor; null when that inventor is unlocated (the next located inventor is not substituted).

schema.name: is_international
schema.description: True when n_countries > 1 (located inventors in two or more countries); False for 0 or 1.

schema.name: assignee_countries
schema.description: Distinct ISO2 codes of the patent's disambiguated assignees' locations on this grant, sorted and ';'-joined; null when the patent has no assignee or none is located.

schema.name: patent_id
schema.description: USPTO patent number as a string, without 'US' prefix or kind code (7-8 digits, e.g. '10000000'; a few dozen 'RE...' ids that PatentsView types as utility). Universe: g_patent rows with patent_type 'utility' and a parseable grant date (8,531,961).

schema.name: grant_year
schema.description: Calendar year of the grant (issue) date g_patent.patent_date, 1976-2025.

schema.name: filing_year
schema.description: Year of the earliest filing_date in g_application for the patent; double because nullable (null for 34 patents). A few source dates are implausible (11 before 1900, 46 after the grant year).

schema.name: ref_count
schema.description: Backward references to US patents printed on the grant: number of g_us_patent_citation rows with this patent as citing patent and a non-null cited number, counting cited patents of any type, duplicate rows and third-party citations; 0 if none. Larger than the utility-only reference sets used by the citation/disruption tables.

schema.name: cpc_code
schema.description: Primary CPC classification: the cpc_group symbol (subclass + group/subgroup, e.g. 'G01S7/4863') of the lowest cpc_sequence row in g_cpc_current, i.e. the current CPC of the snapshot, not the CPC at grant; null for ~0.2% without CPC.

schema.name: cpc_code_list
schema.description: All distinct cpc_group symbols of the patent (inventive and additional), ordered by cpc_sequence and ';'-joined; the first element is cpc_code.

schema.name: inventor_list
schema.description: PatentsView disambiguated inventor_ids (g_inventor_disambiguated), distinct, in inventor_sequence order, ';'-joined. Most ids embed name fragments ('fl:jo_ln:marron-5'); others are 25-character hashes or UUIDs. A few dozen ids contain ';' themselves, so split only where the next id starts, or use n_inventors from patent_inventor_country.

schema.name: assignee_list
schema.description: PatentsView disambiguated assignee_ids (UUIDs, e.g. 'a45783ae-9cec-49bc-bc2e-7b064aaa5907'), distinct, in assignee_sequence order, ';'-joined; null for ~9% of patents with no assignee. Opaque ids; an assignee can be an organisation or an individual person.

schema.name: citing_id
schema.description: Patent number (string, no prefix) of the granted US utility patent making the reference. Rows are distinct (citing_id, cited_id, type); third-party citations dropped, both ends utility, and no grant-year lag filter (rows where the cited patent was granted after the citing one are kept).

schema.name: cited_id
schema.description: The cited document as cited: a granted utility patent number when type = 'granted'; an 11-digit pre-grant publication number (e.g. '20150201176' = publication year + 7-digit serial) when type = 'application'. Join on grant_id, not on this.

schema.name: type
schema.description: 'granted' = reference to a granted patent (g_us_patent_citation); 'application' = reference to a pre-grant publication (g_us_application_citation) that later issued as grant_id. A patent citing both P and P's publication has two rows sharing grant_id.

schema.name: grant_id
schema.description: Granted utility patent the cited document is (granted rows: = cited_id) or became (application rows: via pg_granted_pgpubs_crosswalk); the join key to the other patent tables. Never null in this build, because citations of publications that never issued (~25M) were dropped.

files.grain: One distinct (citing_id, cited_id, type) reference; grant_id identifies the granted cited endpoint.
files.note: Granted and application references may share a grant_id. Deduplicate (citing_id, grant_id) when unique patent edges are required; cited_id preserves the original cited identifier.

schema.name: patent_id
schema.description: USPTO patent number of a granted patent of ANY type: utility (digits), design 'D...', plant 'PP...', reissue 'RE...', SIR 'H...', defensive publication 'T...'; unlike the other tables not limited to utility. Only patents with >= 1 dated citation.

schema.name: SB_B
schema.description: Ke et al. (2015) beauty coefficient from P's yearly citation counts c_t (t = citing grant year - P's grant year >= 0): B = sum_{t=0..t_m} [((c_tm - c_0)/t_m) t + c_0 - c_t] / max(1, c_t), t_m = first year of the maximum. 0 when the peak is in year 0; can be negative; unitless.

schema.name: SB_T
schema.description: Awakening time in years since grant: the t <= t_m with the largest distance from the line through (0, c_0) and (t_m, c_tm); 0 when the peak is in year 0. Integer, 0-48.

schema.name: n_cite
schema.description: Citations the histogram was built from: g_us_patent_citation rows citing P from a granted patent of any type with a non-negative grant-year lag (duplicates and third-party rows included); >= 1.

schema.name: patent_id

schema.name: Z_median
schema.description: Median over P's CPC-subclass pairs of the pair z-score at P's grant year. Kim et al. (2016) z = (o - mu) / sigma, mu = n_a n_b / N, sigma^2 = mu (1 - n_a/N) (N - n_b)/(N - 1), with N, n_a, n_b, o counted over all patents with >= 2 inventional subclasses granted up to and including the grant year; z < 0 = atypical, z set to 0 when sigma = 0; in standard deviations.

schema.name: Z_10pct
schema.description: 10th percentile (numpy, linear interpolation) of P's pair z-scores; same z definition as Z_median.

schema.name: Z_min
schema.description: Minimum of P's pair z-scores: its most atypical subclass pairing.

schema.name: n_pairs
schema.description: Number of subclass pairs scored, k(k-1)/2 for k distinct inventional subclasses (1-820).

schema.name: Z_score
schema.description: Pair z-score on the cumulative set through year t. Kim et al. (2016) z = (o - mu) / sigma, mu = n_a n_b / N, sigma^2 = mu (1 - n_a/N) (N - n_b)/(N - 1), with N, n_a, n_b, o counted over all patents with >= 2 inventional subclasses granted up to and including the grant year; z < 0 = atypical, z set to 0 when sigma = 0; in standard deviations.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000); every node of the de-duplicated application citation graph (distinct citing -> cited pairs from patstat_reference with age >= 0, not replenished), as citer or cited. Nodes that are never cited have NULL CD/F/E/G and -1 in ni/nj/nk.

schema.name: CD_3
schema.description: CD disruption index (ni_3 - nj_3) / (ni_3 + nj_3 + nk_3) over applications dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 3); in [-1, 1]. NULL when the window holds neither a citer nor a citer of a reference (then ni/nj/nk = -1); 0 when it has no citer but its references do (ni = nj = 0, nk > 0).

schema.name: F_3
schema.description: Foundation share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 3) for which down > up, where up = how many of its references (the applications it cites with age >= 0) the citer also cites and down = how many of the focal's other citers in the same window it cites; ties with up = down > 0 count half F, half E. NULL when there is no citer in the window. F + E + G = 1. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3
schema.description: Extension share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 3) with up > down (citer cites more of the focal's references than of its other in-window citers), plus half of the up = down > 0 ties. NULL when there is no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3
schema.description: Generalization share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 3) with up = down = 0 (cite neither the focal's references nor its other in-window citers). NULL when there is no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3
schema.description: Citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 3) that cite none of its references (the applications it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 is the sentinel for 'nothing in the window' (CD_3 NULL), not a count.

schema.name: nj_3
schema.description: Citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 3) that also cite at least one of its references (the applications it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: nk_3
schema.description: Applications dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 3) that cite at least one of the focal's references but not the focal itself (distinct citers of the references minus nj, focal excluded); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: CD_5
schema.description: CD disruption index (ni_5 - nj_5) / (ni_5 + nj_5 + nk_5) over applications dated 0 to 5 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 5); in [-1, 1]. NULL when the window holds neither a citer nor a citer of a reference (then ni/nj/nk = -1); 0 when it has no citer but its references do (ni = nj = 0, nk > 0).

NULL when there is no citer in the window. F + E + G = 1. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.description: Extension share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 5 years after the focal application's filing year (0 <= age <= 5) with up > down (citer cites more of the focal's references than of its other in-window citers), plus half of the up = down > 0 ties. schema.name: pctl_year
schema.description: CD-percentile cohort year: the application's filing year (patstat_metadata.filing_year).

schema.name: pctl_group
schema.description: CD-percentile cohort group: the CPC Section letter (A-H or Y) of patstat_metadata.cpc_code; NULL when there is no CPC code, and then every CD_*_pctl column is NULL.

schema.name: CD_3_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile of CD_3 within its pctl_year x pctl_group cohort, among applications with a non-NULL CD_3: rank() / n on ascending CD, ties share the lowest rank; in (0, 1], higher = more disruptive. NULL when CD_3 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_3_pctl_cume
schema.description: Cumulative percentile of CD_3 in the same cohort: share of the cohort's non-NULL CD_3 values <= this value (ties inclusive); in (0, 1], always >= CD_3_pctl, and differs from it inside CD's large tie blocks (e.g. many CD = 1 or 0). NULL when CD_3 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_5_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile of CD_5 within its pctl_year x pctl_group cohort, among applications with a non-NULL CD_5: rank() / n on ascending CD, ties share the lowest rank; in (0, 1], higher = more disruptive. NULL when CD_5 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_5_pctl_cume
schema.description: Cumulative percentile of CD_5 in the same cohort: share of the cohort's non-NULL CD_5 values <= this value (ties inclusive); in (0, 1], always >= CD_5_pctl, and differs from it inside CD's large tie blocks (e.g. many CD = 1 or 0). NULL when CD_5 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_10_pctl

schema.name: CD_10_pctl_cume
schema.description: Cumulative percentile of CD_10 in the same cohort: share of the cohort's non-NULL CD_10 values <= this value (ties inclusive); in (0, 1], always >= CD_10_pctl, and differs from it inside CD's large tie blocks (e.g. many CD = 1 or 0). NULL when CD_10 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_all_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile of CD_all within its pctl_year x pctl_group cohort, among applications with a non-NULL CD_all: rank() / n on ascending CD, ties share the lowest rank; in (0, 1], higher = more disruptive. NULL when CD_all or pctl_group is NULL.

files.grain: One application in the citation graph with CD, F / E / G and ni / nj / nk per window, plus CD percentiles within filing year x CPC Section.
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000); a focal application with at least one citer in the de-duplicated graph. One row per (application, year) in which ni_new, nj_new or nk_new is non-zero; years without a change have no row.

schema.name: filing_year
schema.description: Clock year of the focal application: the application's filing year (tls201.appln_filing_year, 1900-2023).

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: Calendar filing year of this row = filing_year + yrs_since_filing; the year in which the new citers / co-citers counted in *_new appeared (up to 2023).

schema.name: yrs_since_filing
schema.description: Years since the focal application's filing year (>= 0); the row at age w (or the last row before it) carries the window-w values of patstat_disruption.

schema.name: ni_new
schema.description: Citers of the focal whose filing year is exactly this year and that cite none of its references.

schema.name: nj_new
schema.description: Citers of the focal whose filing year is exactly this year and that also cite at least one of its references.

schema.name: nk_new
schema.description: Applications of exactly this year that cite at least one of the focal's references but not the focal (focal excluded).

schema.name: ni
schema.description: Cumulative ni from age 0 through this row's age; at age w it equals ni_w of patstat_disruption and the last row equals ni_all (checked on every focal application).

schema.name: nj
schema.description: Cumulative nj from age 0 through this row's age (equals nj_w of patstat_disruption at age w).

schema.name: nk
schema.description: Cumulative nk from age 0 through this row's age (equals nk_w of patstat_disruption at age w).

schema.name: CD
schema.description: Disruption index (ni - nj) / (ni + nj + nk) on the cumulative counts, i.e. CD with a window of exactly this age; in [-1, 1], never NaN on a written row.

schema.name: F
schema.description: Share of the citers that have arrived by this age classed Foundation at this age (down > up, with down counted among citers of age <= this age; up = down > 0 ties count half). NaN (a float NaN, not NULL) on rows before the first citer arrives. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E
schema.description: Share of the citers arrived by this age classed Extension (up > down, plus half of the ties); NaN before the first citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G
schema.description: Share of the citers arrived by this age classed Generalization (up = down = 0); NaN before the first citer. F + E + G = 1 when defined. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

files.grain: One application per year with new and cumulative ni / nj / nk, CD and F / E / G.
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: filing_year
schema.description: Cohort year of the focal documents: the application's filing year (tls201.appln_filing_year, 1900-2023).

schema.name: yrs_since_filing
schema.description: Years since the cohort's filing year (>= 0).

schema.name: n_CD
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (filing_year, yrs_since_filing) cell with a finite CD. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal application gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those applications, not every cohort member.

schema.name: CD_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative CD over the n_CD trend rows of this (filing_year, yrs_since_filing) cell (only applications with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others).

schema.name: n_F
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (filing_year, yrs_since_filing) cell with a finite F. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal application gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those applications, not every cohort member.

schema.name: F_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative F (Foundation share) over the n_F trend rows of this (filing_year, yrs_since_filing) cell (only applications with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_F = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: n_E
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (filing_year, yrs_since_filing) cell with a finite E. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal application gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those applications, not every cohort member.

schema.name: E_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative E (Extension share) over the n_E trend rows of this (filing_year, yrs_since_filing) cell (only applications with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_E = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: n_G
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (filing_year, yrs_since_filing) cell with a finite G. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal application gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those applications, not every cohort member.

schema.name: G_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative G (Generalization share) over the n_G trend rows of this (filing_year, yrs_since_filing) cell (only applications with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_G = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

files.grain: One (cohort year, years since) cell with mean cumulative CD / F / E / G.
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: year
schema.description: Cohort year: the application's filing year, 1900-2023.

schema.name: n
schema.description: Number of applications of this cohort in patstat_disruption with a non-NULL CD_all, i.e. with at least one citer: the denominator of the `_all` means. The 3-, 5- and 10-year ni / nj / nk / njfrac means are taken over the subset with something in that window.

schema.name: CD_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of CD_3 (window 3) over the cohort's applications with a non-NULL CD_3 (NULLs ignored); NULL if none.

schema.name: F_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Foundation share F_3 over the cohort's applications with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Extension share E_3 over the cohort's applications with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Generalization share G_3 over the cohort's applications with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of ni_3 (citers that cite none of its references) over the cohort's applications with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a application with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no application of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nj_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of nj_3 (citers that also cite at least one of its references) over the cohort's applications with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a application with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no application of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nk_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of nk_3 (documents citing its references but not it) over the cohort's applications with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a application with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no application of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: njfrac_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of the per-application nj_3 / (ni_3 + nj_3 + nk_3), the share of the 3-year neighbourhood that cites both the application and its references, over the applications with something in the window (the -1 placeholder is read as NULL); NULL when there are none. Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows entered as (-1)/(-3) = 1/3 and pulled the mean toward 0.333.

schema.name: CD_5_mean
schema.description: Mean of CD_5 (window 5) over the cohort's applications with a non-NULL CD_5 (NULLs ignored); NULL if none.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000); one row per application with at least one inventor row in tls207.

schema.name: inventor_list
schema.description: Inventor PATSTAT person_ids as a ';'-joined string in invt_seq_nr order (ties by person_id): a named person once at its lowest sequence, an unnamed placeholder record (empty tls206.person_name, e.g. person_id 263) once per slot, so its id can repeat. Person records, not disambiguated inventors; identical to patstat_metadata.inventor_list.

schema.name: n_inventors
schema.description: Number of inventor slots = length of inventor_list (distinct named persons plus each slot of an unnamed placeholder); team size under its PatentView name. Not tls201.nb_inventors.

schema.name: first_inventor
schema.description: person_id (int64) of the inventor at the lowest sequence position.

schema.name: last_inventor
schema.description: person_id (int64) of the inventor at the highest sequence position (equals first_inventor for a single inventor).

files.grain: One application with inventors: the person_id list in sequence order, its length, first and last (person records, not disambiguated inventors).
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000); one row per application with at least one inventor row (same rows as patstat_inventor).

schema.name: n_inventors
schema.description: Inventor slots under the once-per-named-person / once-per-placeholder-slot rule; identical to patstat_inventor.n_inventors.

schema.name: n_located
schema.description: Inventor slots whose person record has a two-letter country code (tls206.person_ctry_code matching [A-Z]{2}; malformed codes read as unknown); <= n_inventors.

schema.name: countries
schema.description: Distinct inventor country codes, sorted alphabetically, ';'-joined (e.g. 'AU;GB;US'); NULL if no inventor is located. Codes are the address country recorded on that application's person record.

schema.name: n_countries
schema.description: Number of codes in countries; 0 when countries is NULL.

schema.name: country_inventor_counts
schema.description: Inventors per country as 'CC:n' pairs joined by ';', ordered by count descending then code (e.g. 'GB:4;AU:1;US:1'); counts sum to n_located; NULL if none located.

schema.name: first_inventor_country
schema.description: Country of the lowest-sequence inventor; NULL when that inventor has no country (not replaced by the next located inventor).

schema.name: is_international
schema.description: TRUE when n_countries > 1 (inventors in at least two countries).

schema.name: applicant_countries
schema.description: Distinct two-letter country codes of the applicants (all tls207 rows with applt_seq_nr > 0), sorted, ';'-joined; NULL if no applicant is located; identical to patstat_metadata.applicant_ctry_list.

files.grain: One application with inventors: the ISO2 countries of its inventors and applicants.
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000); primary key shared with every other table in this set.

schema.name: appln_auth
schema.description: Two-letter code of the office the application was filed at (tls201.appln_auth), e.g. EP, US, CN, JP, or WO for a PCT international application.

schema.name: appln_kind
schema.description: Application kind code (tls201.appln_kind, trimmed): A = patent application (about 91 % of rows), W = PCT application in the international phase, T = filing that translates or validates an EP / PCT application at some offices; D and the rare remaining codes as defined in the PATSTAT Data Catalog.

schema.name: appln_nr
schema.description: Application number assigned by the filing office, as stored in tls201.appln_nr (a string in DOCDB format, e.g. '515678'); read it together with appln_auth and appln_kind.

schema.name: filing_year
schema.description: Filing year of the application (tls201.appln_filing_year, 1900-2023). The clock year of every metric in this set.

schema.name: filing_date
schema.description: Filing date of the application (tls201.appln_filing_date).

schema.name: priority_year
schema.description: Year of the application's earliest filing date (tls201.earliest_filing_year: earliest of its own filing, its PCT application, its Paris-convention priorities, technical relations and continuations, direct links only); NULL replaces PATSTAT's 9999 default. Equals filing_year when no earlier linked filing exists; can precede 1900 (min 1819) because the 1900 floor applies to filing years only.

schema.name: publn_year
schema.description: Year of the application's earliest publication (tls201.earliest_publn_year); NULL where PATSTAT has 9999 (no dated publication).

schema.name: grant_year
schema.description: Year of the application's first grant publication (min year of tls211 publications flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y'); NULL when there is none, including about 0.76 M applications flagged granted only through a legal event.

schema.name: granted
schema.description: PATSTAT's granted flag (tls201.granted = 'Y'): a first-grant publication or an IP-right-grant legal event exists; for WO applications, granted in at least one designated state. TRUE for about 54 %.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id): applications sharing exactly the same priorities; the key of the family set (PATSTAT/output_family/).

schema.name: docdb_family_size
schema.description: PATSTAT's count of applications in the DOCDB simple family (tls201.docdb_family_size), all members including those outside this universe; 1 = the only member.

schema.name: inpadoc_family_id
schema.description: INPADOC extended-family id (tls201.inpadoc_family_id): applications linked directly or indirectly through priorities, PCT routes, technical relations or continuations; an integer id passed through from PATSTAT.

schema.name: nb_citing_docdb_fam
schema.description: PATSTAT's own family-level forward-citation count (tls201.nb_citing_docdb_fam): distinct DOCDB families citing any publication or application of this application's family, taken as-is from PATSTAT (this pipeline applies no window, universe or provenance filter to it); not the same as C / uniqueC.

schema.name: nb_applicants
schema.description: PATSTAT's count of applicants on the most recent publication carrying Latin-script names (tls201.nb_applicants); 0 when none does, so it can disagree with applicant_list.

schema.name: nb_inventors
schema.description: PATSTAT's count of inventors on the most recent publication carrying Latin-script names (tls201.nb_inventors); 0 when none does, so it can disagree with inventor_list and patstat_inventor.n_inventors.

schema.name: ref_count
schema.description: Number of distinct cited applications for which this application is the citer in this set's patstat_reference (both ends in the universe, third-party and replenished rows excluded, self-citations dropped, NO age filter so later-filed references count); 0 if none.

schema.name: npl_ref_count
schema.description: Number of distinct non-patent-literature documents (tls212.cited_npl_publn_id <> '0') cited by any publication of the application, replenished rows excluded (third-party NPL not removed); 0 if none.

schema.name: ipc_main
schema.description: Main IPC symbol (tls209 row with ipc_position = 'F', whitespace removed, e.g. 'C07D499/06'; alphabetically first if several); NULL if none.

schema.name: cpc_code
schema.description: One representative CPC symbol (tls224, whitespace removed, e.g. 'G06K7/0013'): the alphabetically first symbol in the same 4-character subclass as ipc_main, else the alphabetically first symbol; NULL if no CPC. Its first letter is the CD-percentile group.

schema.name: cpc_code_list
schema.description: All distinct CPC symbols of the application (whitespace removed), sorted, ';'-joined; NULL if no CPC.

schema.name: cpc_subclass_list
schema.description: Distinct 4-character CPC subclasses (e.g. 'A61P;C07D'), sorted, ';'-joined; the atypicality input; NULL if no CPC.

schema.name: techn_field_nr
schema.description: WIPO technology field 1-35 (Schmoch 2008 concordance, tls230_appln_techn_field) with the largest weight, ties to the lowest number; NULL if PATSTAT assigns none. Field names in ps_common.WIPO_FIELD.

schema.name: wipo_sector
schema.description: WIPO sector of techn_field_nr: Electrical engineering (fields 1-8), Instruments (9-13), Chemistry (14-24), Mechanical engineering (25-32), Other fields (33-35); NULL when techn_field_nr is NULL. The hit-probability cohort sector.

schema.name: inventor_list
schema.description: Inventor PATSTAT person_ids (tls207 rows with invt_seq_nr > 0) as a ';'-joined string in invt_seq_nr order (ties by person_id): a named person once at its lowest sequence, an unnamed placeholder record (empty tls206.person_name) once per slot, so its id can repeat. person_ids are per-record, not disambiguated inventors; NULL if no inventor.

schema.name: applicant_list
schema.description: Applicant PATSTAT person_ids (tls207 rows with applt_seq_nr > 0), ';'-joined in applt_seq_nr order with the same once-per-named-person rule; person and company records, not disambiguated; NULL if no applicant.

schema.name: inventor_ctry_list
schema.description: Distinct two-letter country codes of the inventors (tls206.person_ctry_code of each person record; only [A-Z]{2} codes count, malformed ones are read as unknown), sorted, ';'-joined; NULL if no inventor has one (common for CN and JP filings).

schema.name: applicant_ctry_list
schema.description: Distinct two-letter country codes of the applicants (tls206.person_ctry_code, [A-Z]{2} only), sorted, ';'-joined; NULL if none.

schema.name: applicant_sector
schema.description: PATSTAT standardised-name sector (tls206.psn_sector) of the applicant at sequence number 1: COMPANY, INDIVIDUAL, UNIVERSITY, GOV NON-PROFIT, HOSPITAL, UNKNOWN or a space-joined combination (e.g. 'GOV NON-PROFIT UNIVERSITY'); NULL if missing or blank.

files.grain: One application (appln_id) in the universe: a patent of invention, a real application, filed 1900-2023, with its office, years, family, classification, WIPO sector and persons.
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: citing_id
schema.description: appln_id of the citing application (in the universe).

schema.name: cited_id
schema.description: appln_id of the cited application (in the universe); never equal to citing_id (self-citations through another publication are dropped).

schema.name: citing_publn_id
schema.description: tls211 pat_publn_id of the citing publication on which the citation is recorded (e.g. the A1 search-report publication or the B1 grant of the citing application).

schema.name: cited_publn_id
schema.description: tls211 pat_publn_id of the cited publication (tls212.cited_pat_publn_id); 0 exactly when the citation names an application instead (resolved = 'appln').

schema.name: citing_year
schema.description: Filing year of the citing application (tls201.appln_filing_year).

schema.name: cited_year
schema.description: Filing year of the cited application.

schema.name: age
schema.description: citing_year - cited_year in years. Can be negative (a search report citing a later-filed document); such rows are kept here, and every metric requires age >= 0 (ps.EDGE_WHERE).

schema.name: citing_publn_year
schema.description: Year of the citing publication's date (tls211.publn_date), a publication-based alternative clock; 9999 = date unknown in PATSTAT (a few hundred rows).

schema.name: citn_origin
schema.description: PATSTAT citation origin (tls212.citn_origin, trimmed): APP applicant, SEA search report, ISR international search report, SUP supplementary search report, PRS USPTO pre-search, EXA examination, FOP filed opposition, CH2 PCT chapter II, OPP opposition division, APL appeal. Third-party observations (115, TPO) are excluded upstream.

schema.name: bucket
schema.description: Provenance bucket of citn_origin (ps.bucket_sql): 'applicant' = APP; 'examiner' = SEA, ISR, SUP, PRS, EXA, FOP, CH2; 'other' = anything else (OPP, APL, blank).

schema.name: replenished
schema.description: TRUE when PATSTAT copied the citation onto the citing publication from another publication (tls212.citn_replenished <> 0: Euro-PCT EP publications filled with the citations of their WO international publication). Kept for completeness; excluded from every count by ps.EDGE_WHERE.

schema.name: resolved
schema.description: How the cited end was resolved: 'publn' = via tls212.cited_pat_publn_id -> tls211 -> appln_id; 'appln' = via tls212.cited_appln_id directly (about 0.15 % of rows in the filing set).

files.grain: One citation row resolved to (citing application, cited application), with both clock years, age, the recorded origin and its examiner / applicant / other bucket, and a replenished flag.
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000); a cited application with at least one counted citation (same rows as patstat_citation).

schema.name: SB_B
schema.description: Ke et al. (2015) beauty coefficient from the yearly histogram of citation rows (not distinct citing applications) by age 0 .. last cited age (age >= 0, not replenished): sum over t <= t_m of (line from (0, c_0) to the peak (t_m, c_m) minus c_t) / max(c_t, 1). 0 when the first maximum is at age 0 (also the value for a single-year histogram); can be negative (min about -5); float32.

schema.name: SB_T
schema.description: Awakening time: the age t <= t_m (years since the application's filing year) at which the histogram lies farthest from the line joining (0, c_0) and the peak; 0 when the peak is at age 0.

schema.name: n_cite
schema.description: Total citation rows (not distinct citing applications) in the histogram, i.e. C_all of patstat_citation.

files.grain: One cited application with its beauty coefficient and awakening time.
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000); the cited application. One row per (application, year) with at least one new citing application.

schema.name: filing_year
schema.description: Clock year of the cited application: the application's filing year (tls201.appln_filing_year, 1900-2023).

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: filing_year + yrs_since_filing: the filing year of the citing applications counted in this row.

schema.name: yrs_since_filing
schema.description: Lag in years from the cited application's filing year to the citer's (the minimum over the pair's edges, which is the only lag because both ends have one clock year each); >= 0.

schema.name: uniqueC
schema.description: Number of distinct citing applications whose citation of this application falls at this lag. Cumulative sums over lags <= 3/5/10/all reproduce uniqueC_3/5/10/all of patstat_citation, and the column equals patstat_citation_trend.uniqueC row for row (both asserted in the notebook).

files.grain: One cited application per year since filing (grant) with its new distinct citing applications.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000); a application with at least two distinct CPC subclasses (its distinct 4-character CPC subclasses (tls224, whitespace removed)).

schema.name: Z_median
schema.description: Median over the application's subclass pairs of the pair z-score (Kim et al. (2016) hypergeometric z of a CPC-subclass pair in the application's filing year, with counts cumulative over all applications with >= 2 subclasses up to and including that year; z < 0 = atypical pair).

schema.name: Z_10pct
schema.description: 10th percentile (linear interpolation, DuckDB quantile_cont) of the application's pair z-scores; low values flag atypical combinations.

schema.name: Z_min
schema.description: Minimum pair z-score of the application (its most atypical subclass pair).

schema.name: n_pairs
schema.description: Number of distinct CPC-subclass pairs scored = k(k-1)/2 for k distinct subclasses.

files.grain: One application with at least two CPC subclasses: atypicality z summaries.
files.note: Filing clock: filing years at both ends, every application.

schema.name: code_1
schema.description: First CPC subclass of the pair (4 characters, e.g. 'A01B'); always alphabetically lower than code_2.

schema.name: code_2
schema.description: Second CPC subclass of the pair (4 characters); alphabetically higher than code_1.

schema.name: year
schema.description: Year in which at least one application with >= 2 subclasses carries this pair, on this set's clock: the application's filing year (tls201.appln_filing_year, 1900-2023).

schema.name: Z_score
schema.description: Hypergeometric z = (o - mu) / sqrt(var) with mu = n_a n_b / N and var = mu (1 - n_a / N) (N - n_b) / (N - 1), where N, n_a, n_b and o (co-occurrences) count applications with >= 2 subclasses cumulatively through this year inclusive; 0 when var <= 0. z < 0 = rarer than chance (atypical).

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000) of a granted application (grant year 1900-2023); every node of the de-duplicated application citation graph (distinct citing -> cited pairs from patstat_reference with age >= 0, not replenished), as citer or cited. Nodes that are never cited have NULL CD/F/E/G and -1 in ni/nj/nk.

schema.name: CD_3
schema.description: CD disruption index (ni_3 - nj_3) / (ni_3 + nj_3 + nk_3) over applications dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's grant year (0 <= age <= 3); in [-1, 1]. NULL when the window holds neither a citer nor a citer of a reference (then ni/nj/nk = -1); 0 when it has no citer but its references do (ni = nj = 0, nk > 0).

schema.name: F_3
schema.description: Foundation share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's grant year (0 <= age <= 3) for which down > up, where up = how many of its references (the applications it cites with age >= 0) the citer also cites and down = how many of the focal's other citers in the same window it cites; ties with up = down > 0 count half F, half E. NULL when there is no citer in the window. F + E + G = 1. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3
schema.description: Extension share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's grant year (0 <= age <= 3) with up > down (citer cites more of the focal's references than of its other in-window citers), plus half of the up = down > 0 ties. NULL when there is no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3
schema.description: Generalization share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's grant year (0 <= age <= 3) with up = down = 0 (cite neither the focal's references nor its other in-window citers). NULL when there is no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3
schema.description: Citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's grant year (0 <= age <= 3) that cite none of its references (the applications it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 is the sentinel for 'nothing in the window' (CD_3 NULL), not a count.

schema.name: nj_3
schema.description: Citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's grant year (0 <= age <= 3) that also cite at least one of its references (the applications it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: nk_3
schema.description: Applications dated 0 to 3 years after the focal application's grant year (0 <= age <= 3) that cite at least one of the focal's references but not the focal itself (distinct citers of the references minus nj, focal excluded); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: pctl_year
schema.description: CD-percentile cohort year: the application's FILING year (patstat_metadata.filing_year), not its grant year; the cohort stays filing year x CPC Section in the grant set, as in PatentView.

schema.name: pctl_group
schema.description: CD-percentile cohort group: the CPC Section letter (A-H or Y) of patstat_metadata.cpc_code; NULL when there is no CPC code, and then every CD_*_pctl column is NULL.

schema.name: CD_3_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile of CD_3 within its pctl_year x pctl_group cohort, among applications with a non-NULL CD_3: rank() / n on ascending CD, ties share the lowest rank; in (0, 1], higher = more disruptive. NULL when CD_3 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_3_pctl_cume
schema.description: Cumulative percentile of CD_3 in the same cohort: share of the cohort's non-NULL CD_3 values <= this value (ties inclusive); in (0, 1], always >= CD_3_pctl, and differs from it inside CD's large tie blocks (e.g. many CD = 1 or 0). NULL when CD_3 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000) of a granted application (grant year 1900-2023); a focal application with at least one citer in the de-duplicated graph. One row per (application, year) in which ni_new, nj_new or nk_new is non-zero; years without a change have no row.

schema.name: grant_year
schema.description: Clock year of the focal application: the grant year, i.e. the year of the application's first publication flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y' (1900-2023).

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: Calendar grant year of this row = grant_year + yrs_since_grant; the year in which the new citers / co-citers counted in *_new appeared (up to 2023).

schema.name: yrs_since_grant
schema.description: Years since the focal application's grant year (>= 0); the row at age w (or the last row before it) carries the window-w values of patstat_disruption.

schema.name: ni_new
schema.description: Citers of the focal whose grant year is exactly this year and that cite none of its references.

schema.name: nj_new
schema.description: Citers of the focal whose grant year is exactly this year and that also cite at least one of its references.

schema.name: nk_new
schema.description: Applications of exactly this year that cite at least one of the focal's references but not the focal (focal excluded).

schema.name: ni
schema.description: Cumulative ni from age 0 through this row's age; at age w it equals ni_w of patstat_disruption and the last row equals ni_all (checked on every focal application).

schema.name: nj
schema.description: Cumulative nj from age 0 through this row's age (equals nj_w of patstat_disruption at age w).

schema.name: nk
schema.description: Cumulative nk from age 0 through this row's age (equals nk_w of patstat_disruption at age w).

schema.name: CD
schema.description: Disruption index (ni - nj) / (ni + nj + nk) on the cumulative counts, i.e. CD with a window of exactly this age; in [-1, 1], never NaN on a written row.

schema.name: F
schema.description: Share of the citers that have arrived by this age classed Foundation at this age (down > up, with down counted among citers of age <= this age; up = down > 0 ties count half). NaN (a float NaN, not NULL) on rows before the first citer arrives. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E
schema.description: Share of the citers arrived by this age classed Extension (up > down, plus half of the ties); NaN before the first citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G
schema.description: Share of the citers arrived by this age classed Generalization (up = down = 0); NaN before the first citer. F + E + G = 1 when defined. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

files.grain: One application per year with new and cumulative ni / nj / nk, CD and F / E / G.
files.note: Grant clock: grant years at both ends, granted applications only.

schema.name: grant_year
schema.description: Cohort year of the focal documents: the grant year, i.e. the year of the application's first publication flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y' (1900-2023).

schema.name: yrs_since_grant
schema.description: Years since the cohort's grant year (>= 0).

schema.name: n_CD
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (grant_year, yrs_since_grant) cell with a finite CD. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal application gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those applications, not every cohort member.

schema.name: CD_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative CD over the n_CD trend rows of this (grant_year, yrs_since_grant) cell (only applications with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others).

schema.name: n_F
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (grant_year, yrs_since_grant) cell with a finite F. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal application gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those applications, not every cohort member.

schema.name: F_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative F (Foundation share) over the n_F trend rows of this (grant_year, yrs_since_grant) cell (only applications with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_F = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: n_E
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (grant_year, yrs_since_grant) cell with a finite E. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal application gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those applications, not every cohort member.

schema.name: E_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative E (Extension share) over the n_E trend rows of this (grant_year, yrs_since_grant) cell (only applications with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_E = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: n_G
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (grant_year, yrs_since_grant) cell with a finite G. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal application gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those applications, not every cohort member.

schema.name: G_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative G (Generalization share) over the n_G trend rows of this (grant_year, yrs_since_grant) cell (only applications with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_G = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

files.grain: One (cohort year, years since) cell with mean cumulative CD / F / E / G.
files.note: Grant clock: grant years at both ends, granted applications only.

schema.name: year
schema.description: Cohort year: the grant year (first publication flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y'), 1900-2023.

schema.name: n
schema.description: Number of applications of this cohort in patstat_disruption with a non-NULL CD_all, i.e. with at least one citer: the denominator of the `_all` means. The 3-, 5- and 10-year ni / nj / nk / njfrac means are taken over the subset with something in that window.

schema.name: CD_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of CD_3 (window 3) over the cohort's applications with a non-NULL CD_3 (NULLs ignored); NULL if none.

schema.name: F_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Foundation share F_3 over the cohort's applications with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Extension share E_3 over the cohort's applications with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Generalization share G_3 over the cohort's applications with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of ni_3 (citers that cite none of its references) over the cohort's applications with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a application with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no application of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nj_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of nj_3 (citers that also cite at least one of its references) over the cohort's applications with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a application with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no application of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nk_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of nk_3 (documents citing its references but not it) over the cohort's applications with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a application with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no application of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: njfrac_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of the per-application nj_3 / (ni_3 + nj_3 + nk_3), the share of the 3-year neighbourhood that cites both the application and its references, over the applications with something in the window (the -1 placeholder is read as NULL); NULL when there are none. Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows entered as (-1)/(-3) = 1/3 and pulled the mean toward 0.333.

schema.name: CD_5_mean
schema.description: Mean of CD_5 (window 5) over the cohort's applications with a non-NULL CD_5 (NULLs ignored); NULL if none.

schema.name: F_5_mean
schema.description: Mean Foundation share F_5 over the cohort's applications with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_5_mean
