schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000) of a granted application (grant year 1900-2023); primary key shared with every other table in this set (the grant-clock universe).

schema.name: appln_auth
schema.description: Two-letter code of the office the application was filed at (tls201.appln_auth), e.g. EP, US, CN, JP, or WO for a PCT international application.

schema.name: appln_kind
schema.description: Application kind code (tls201.appln_kind, trimmed): A = patent application (about 91 % of rows), W = PCT application in the international phase, T = filing that translates or validates an EP / PCT application at some offices; D and the rare remaining codes as defined in the PATSTAT Data Catalog.

schema.name: appln_nr
schema.description: Application number assigned by the filing office, as stored in tls201.appln_nr (a string in DOCDB format, e.g. '515678'); read it together with appln_auth and appln_kind.

schema.name: filing_year
schema.description: Filing year of the application (tls201.appln_filing_year, 1900-2023). Not the clock here (this set dates by grant_year), but it is the CD-percentile cohort year (pctl_year) of patstat_disruption.

schema.name: filing_date
schema.description: Filing date of the application (tls201.appln_filing_date).

schema.name: priority_year
schema.description: Year of the application's earliest filing date (tls201.earliest_filing_year: earliest of its own filing, its PCT application, its Paris-convention priorities, technical relations and continuations, direct links only); NULL replaces PATSTAT's 9999 default. Equals filing_year when no earlier linked filing exists; can precede 1900 (min 1819) because the 1900 floor applies to filing years only.

schema.name: publn_year
schema.description: Year of the application's earliest publication (tls201.earliest_publn_year); NULL where PATSTAT has 9999 (no dated publication).

schema.name: grant_year
schema.description: Year of the application's first grant publication (min year of tls211 publications flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y'); the clock year of every metric in this set, 1900-2023, never NULL here.

schema.name: granted
schema.description: PATSTAT's granted flag (tls201.granted = 'Y'); always TRUE in this set, which holds only applications with a grant publication.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id): applications sharing exactly the same priorities; the key of the family set (PATSTAT/output_family/).

schema.name: docdb_family_size
schema.description: PATSTAT's count of applications in the DOCDB simple family (tls201.docdb_family_size), all members including those outside this universe; 1 = the only member.

schema.name: inpadoc_family_id
schema.description: INPADOC extended-family id (tls201.inpadoc_family_id): applications linked directly or indirectly through priorities, PCT routes, technical relations or continuations; an integer id passed through from PATSTAT.

schema.name: nb_citing_docdb_fam
schema.description: PATSTAT's own family-level forward-citation count (tls201.nb_citing_docdb_fam): distinct DOCDB families citing any publication or application of this application's family, taken as-is from PATSTAT (this pipeline applies no window, universe or provenance filter to it); not the same as C / uniqueC.

schema.name: nb_applicants
schema.description: PATSTAT's count of applicants on the most recent publication carrying Latin-script names (tls201.nb_applicants); 0 when none does, so it can disagree with applicant_list.

schema.name: nb_inventors
schema.description: PATSTAT's count of inventors on the most recent publication carrying Latin-script names (tls201.nb_inventors); 0 when none does, so it can disagree with inventor_list and patstat_inventor.n_inventors.

schema.name: ref_count
schema.description: Number of distinct cited applications for which this application is the citer in this set's patstat_reference (both ends in the grant-clock universe, third-party and replenished rows excluded, self-citations dropped, NO age filter so later-granted references count); 0 if none.

schema.name: npl_ref_count

schema.name: ipc_main

schema.name: cpc_code_list
schema.description: All distinct CPC symbols of the application (whitespace removed), sorted, ';'-joined; NULL if no CPC.

schema.name: cpc_subclass_list
schema.description: Distinct 4-character CPC subclasses (e.g. 'A61P;C07D'), sorted, ';'-joined; the atypicality input; NULL if no CPC.

schema.name: techn_field_nr
schema.description: WIPO technology field 1-35 (Schmoch 2008 concordance, tls230_appln_techn_field) with the largest weight, ties to the lowest number; NULL if PATSTAT assigns none. Field names in ps_common.WIPO_FIELD.

schema.name: wipo_sector
schema.description: WIPO sector of techn_field_nr: Electrical engineering (fields 1-8), Instruments (9-13), Chemistry (14-24), Mechanical engineering (25-32), Other fields (33-35); NULL when techn_field_nr is NULL. The hit-probability cohort sector.

schema.name: inventor_list
schema.description: Inventor PATSTAT person_ids (tls207 rows with invt_seq_nr > 0) as a ';'-joined string in invt_seq_nr order (ties by person_id): a named person once at its lowest sequence, an unnamed placeholder record (empty tls206.person_name) once per slot, so its id can repeat. person_ids are per-record, not disambiguated inventors; NULL if no inventor.

schema.name: applicant_list

schema.name: inventor_ctry_list

schema.name: applicant_ctry_list

schema.name: applicant_sector

schema.description: Grant year of the citing application (year of its first publication flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y').

schema.name: cited_year
schema.description: Grant year of the cited application.

schema.name: age
schema.description: citing_year - cited_year in years. Can be negative (a search report citing a later-granted document); such rows are kept here, and every metric requires age >= 0 (ps.EDGE_WHERE).

schema.name: citing_publn_year
schema.description: Year of the citing publication's date (tls211.publn_date), a publication-based alternative clock; 9999 = date unknown in PATSTAT (a few hundred rows).

schema.description: PATSTAT citation origin (tls212.citn_origin, trimmed): APP applicant, SEA search report, ISR international search report, SUP supplementary search report, PRS USPTO pre-search, EXA examination, FOP filed opposition, CH2 PCT chapter II, OPP opposition division, APL appeal. schema.name: bucket

schema.name: replenished
schema.description: TRUE when PATSTAT copied the citation onto the citing publication from another publication (tls212.citn_replenished <> 0: Euro-PCT EP publications filled with the citations of their WO international publication). Kept for completeness; excluded from every count by ps.EDGE_WHERE.

schema.name: resolved
schema.description: How the cited end was resolved: 'publn' = via tls212.cited_pat_publn_id -> tls211 -> appln_id; 'appln' = via tls212.cited_appln_id directly (about 0.15 % of rows in the filing set).

schema.name: SB_B
schema.description: Ke et al. (2015) beauty coefficient from the yearly histogram of citation rows (not distinct citing applications) by age 0 .. last cited age (age >= 0, not replenished): sum over t <= t_m of (line from (0, c_0) to the peak (t_m, c_m) minus c_t) / max(c_t, 1). 0 when the first maximum is at age 0 (also the value for a single-year histogram); can be negative (min about -5); float32.

schema.name: SB_T
schema.description: Awakening time: the age t <= t_m (years since the application's grant year) at which the histogram lies farthest from the line joining (0, c_0) and the peak; 0 when the peak is at age 0.

schema.name: n_cite
schema.description: Total citation rows (not distinct citing applications) in the histogram, i.e. C_all of patstat_citation.

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000) of a granted application (grant year 1900-2023); the cited application. One row per (application, year) with at least one new citing application.

schema.name: grant_year
schema.description: Clock year of the cited application: the grant year, i.e. the year of the application's first publication flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y' (1900-2023).

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: grant_year + yrs_since_grant: the grant year of the citing applications counted in this row.

schema.name: yrs_since_grant
schema.description: Lag in years from the cited application's grant year to the citer's (the minimum over the pair's edges, which is the only lag because both ends have one clock year each); >= 0.

schema.name: uniqueC
schema.description: Number of distinct citing applications whose citation of this application falls at this lag. Cumulative sums over lags <= 3/5/10/all reproduce uniqueC_3/5/10/all of patstat_citation, and the column equals patstat_citation_trend.uniqueC row for row (both asserted in the notebook).

schema.name: appln_id
schema.description: PATSTAT application id (tls201.appln_id, integer < 900,000,000) of a granted application (grant year 1900-2023); a application with at least two distinct CPC subclasses (its distinct 4-character CPC subclasses (tls224, whitespace removed)).

schema.name: Z_median
schema.description: Median over the application's subclass pairs of the pair z-score (Kim et al. (2016) hypergeometric z of a CPC-subclass pair in the application's grant year, with counts cumulative over all applications with >= 2 subclasses up to and including that year; z < 0 = atypical pair).

schema.name: Z_10pct
schema.description: 10th percentile (linear interpolation, DuckDB quantile_cont) of the application's pair z-scores; low values flag atypical combinations.

schema.name: Z_min
schema.description: Minimum pair z-score of the application (its most atypical subclass pair).

schema.name: n_pairs
schema.description: Number of distinct CPC-subclass pairs scored = k(k-1)/2 for k distinct subclasses.

files.grain: One application with at least two CPC subclasses: atypicality z summaries.
files.note: Grant clock: grant years at both ends, granted applications only.

schema.name: code_1
schema.description: First CPC subclass of the pair (4 characters, e.g. 'A01B'); always alphabetically lower than code_2.

schema.name: code_2
schema.description: Second CPC subclass of the pair (4 characters); alphabetically higher than code_1.

schema.name: year
schema.description: Year in which at least one application with >= 2 subclasses carries this pair, on this set's clock: the grant year, i.e. the year of the application's first publication flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y' (1900-2023).

schema.name: Z_score
schema.description: Hypergeometric z = (o - mu) / sqrt(var) with mu = n_a n_b / N and var = mu (1 - n_a / N) (N - n_b) / (N - 1), where N, n_a, n_b and o (co-occurrences) count applications with >= 2 subclasses cumulatively through this year inclusive; 0 when var <= 0. z < 0 = rarer than chance (atypical).

files.grain: One CPC-subclass pair per cohort year.

schema.name: uniqueC_all
schema.description: Distinct citing DOCDB families whose priority year is the same as or later than this family's priority year (age >= 0, no upper bound: every year up to the 2023 snapshot), each counted once however many rows it contributes; the de-duplicated impact count to use.

schema.name: uniqueC_examiner_all
schema.description: Distinct citing DOCDB families within the same window that cite this family through at least one 'examiner'-bucket row (citn_origin SEA, ISR, SUP, PRS, EXA, FOP or CH2: search-report, examination, opposition-filing and PCT chapter II citations). A citer using several buckets counts in each, so the three bucket counts can sum to more than uniqueC_all.

schema.name: uniqueC_applicant_all
schema.description: Distinct citing DOCDB families within the same window that cite this family through at least one 'applicant'-bucket row (citn_origin APP: references submitted by the applicant). A citer using several buckets counts in each, so the three bucket counts can sum to more than uniqueC_all.

schema.name: uniqueC_other_all
schema.description: Distinct citing DOCDB families within the same window that cite this family through at least one 'other'-bucket row (citn_origin OPP, APL or blank: opposition-division and appeal citations). A citer using several buckets counts in each, so the three bucket counts can sum to more than uniqueC_all.

files.grain: One cited application with citation rows (C) and distinct citing applications (uniqueC) per window and provenance bucket.
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id, integer); the cited family. One row per (family, citing year) with at least one counted citation.

schema.name: priority_year
schema.description: Clock year of the cited family: the family's earliest priority year (min over its universe members of tls201.earliest_filing_year, the filing year where that is 9999). A few precede 1900 (min 1819) because the 1900 floor applies to filing years only.

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: Priority year of the citing DOCDB families counted in this row (the citing family's clock year, not the publication year of the citation).

schema.name: yrs_since_priority
schema.description: Years since the cited family's priority year: cite_year - priority_year (integer, >= 0; ps.EDGE_WHERE drops negative ages).

schema.name: C
schema.description: Family citation rows received in this citing year: one row per (citing family, provenance bucket), so a family citing under two buckets counts twice; within-family and replenished citations excluded. Summing over years gives C_all of patstat_citation.

schema.name: C_examiner
schema.description: The 'examiner' part of C in this year (citn_origin SEA, ISR, SUP, PRS, EXA, FOP or CH2: search-report, examination, opposition-filing and PCT chapter II citations); C = C_examiner + C_applicant + C_other.

schema.name: C_applicant
schema.description: The 'applicant' part of C in this year (citn_origin APP: references submitted by the applicant); C = C_examiner + C_applicant + C_other.

schema.name: C_other
schema.description: The 'other' part of C in this year (citn_origin OPP, APL or blank: opposition-division and appeal citations); C = C_examiner + C_applicant + C_other.

schema.name: uniqueC
schema.description: Distinct citing DOCDB families in this citing year. A citer has one clock year, so the yearly values sum exactly to uniqueC_all of patstat_citation.

files.grain: One cited application per citing year.
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id, integer); every node of the de-duplicated family citation graph (distinct citing family -> cited family pairs with age >= 0), as citer or cited. Nodes that are never cited have NULL CD/F/E/G and -1 in ni/nj/nk.

schema.name: CD_3
schema.description: CD disruption index (ni_3 - nj_3) / (ni_3 + nj_3 + nk_3) over families dated 0 to 3 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 3); in [-1, 1]. NULL when the window holds neither a citer nor a citer of a reference (then ni/nj/nk = -1); 0 when it has no citer but its references do (ni = nj = 0, nk > 0).

schema.name: F_3
schema.description: Foundation share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 3) for which down > up, where up = how many of its references (the families it cites with age >= 0) the citer also cites and down = how many of the focal's other citers in the same window it cites; ties with up = down > 0 count half F, half E. NULL when there is no citer in the window. F + E + G = 1. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3
schema.description: Extension share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 3) with up > down (citer cites more of the focal's references than of its other in-window citers), plus half of the up = down > 0 ties. NULL when there is no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3
schema.description: Generalization share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 3) with up = down = 0 (cite neither the focal's references nor its other in-window citers). NULL when there is no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3
schema.description: Citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 3) that cite none of its references (the families it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 is the sentinel for 'nothing in the window' (CD_3 NULL), not a count.

schema.name: nj_3
schema.description: Citers dated 0 to 3 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 3) that also cite at least one of its references (the families it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: nk_3
schema.description: Families dated 0 to 3 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 3) that cite at least one of the focal's references but not the focal itself (distinct citers of the references minus nj, focal excluded); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: CD_5

NULL when the window holds neither a citer nor a citer of a reference (then ni/nj/nk = -1); 0 when it has no citer but its references do (ni = nj = 0, nk > 0).

NULL when there is no citer in the window. F + E + G = 1. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_10
schema.description: Generalization share: fraction of the citers dated 0 to 10 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 10) with up = down = 0 (cite neither the focal's references nor its other in-window citers). NULL when there is no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_10
schema.description: Citers dated 0 to 10 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 10) that cite none of its references (the families it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 is the sentinel for 'nothing in the window' (CD_10 NULL), not a count.

schema.name: nj_10
schema.description: Citers dated 0 to 10 years after the focal family's priority year (0 <= age <= 10) that also cite at least one of its references (the families it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: CD_all
schema.description: CD disruption index (ni_all - nj_all) / (ni_all + nj_all + nk_all) over families dated at any time from the focal family's priority year on (age >= 0); in [-1, 1]. NULL when the window holds neither a citer nor a citer of a reference (then ni/nj/nk = -1); 0 when it has no citer but its references do (ni = nj = 0, nk > 0).

schema.name: F_all
schema.description: Foundation share: fraction of the citers dated at any time from the focal family's priority year on (age >= 0) for which down > up, where up = how many of its references (the families it cites with age >= 0) the citer also cites and down = how many of the focal's other citers in the same window it cites; ties with up = down > 0 count half F, half E. NULL when there is no citer in the window. F + E + G = 1. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.description: Generalization share: fraction of the citers dated at any time from the focal family's priority year on (age >= 0) with up = down = 0 (cite neither the focal's references nor its other in-window citers). NULL when there is no citer in the window. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_all
schema.description: Citers dated at any time from the focal family's priority year on (age >= 0) that cite none of its references (the families it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 is the sentinel for 'nothing in the window' (CD_all NULL), not a count.

schema.name: nj_all
schema.description: Citers dated at any time from the focal family's priority year on (age >= 0) that also cite at least one of its references (the families it cites with age >= 0) (count); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: nk_all
schema.description: Families dated at any time from the focal family's priority year on (age >= 0) that cite at least one of the focal's references but not the focal itself (distinct citers of the references minus nj, focal excluded); -1 sentinel when nothing is in the window.

schema.name: pctl_year
schema.description: CD-percentile cohort year: the filing year of the family's earliest-filed universe member (patstat_metadata.filing_year in this set), not the priority year.

schema.name: pctl_group
schema.description: CD-percentile cohort group: the CPC Section letter (A-H or Y) of patstat_metadata.cpc_code (from the earliest-filed member with a CPC code); NULL when there is no CPC code, and then every CD_*_pctl column is NULL.

schema.name: CD_3_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile of CD_3 within its pctl_year x pctl_group cohort, among families with a non-NULL CD_3: rank() / n on ascending CD, ties share the lowest rank; in (0, 1], higher = more disruptive. NULL when CD_3 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_3_pctl_cume
schema.description: Cumulative percentile of CD_3 in the same cohort: share of the cohort's non-NULL CD_3 values <= this value (ties inclusive); in (0, 1], always >= CD_3_pctl, and differs from it inside CD's large tie blocks (e.g. many CD = 1 or 0). NULL when CD_3 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_5_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile of CD_5 within its pctl_year x pctl_group cohort, among families with a non-NULL CD_5: rank() / n on ascending CD, ties share the lowest rank; in (0, 1], higher = more disruptive. NULL when CD_5 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_5_pctl_cume
schema.description: Cumulative percentile of CD_5 in the same cohort: share of the cohort's non-NULL CD_5 values <= this value (ties inclusive); in (0, 1], always >= CD_5_pctl, and differs from it inside CD's large tie blocks (e.g. many CD = 1 or 0). NULL when CD_5 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_10_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile of CD_10 within its pctl_year x pctl_group cohort, among families with a non-NULL CD_10: rank() / n on ascending CD, ties share the lowest rank; in (0, 1], higher = more disruptive. NULL when CD_10 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_10_pctl_cume
schema.description: Cumulative percentile of CD_10 in the same cohort: share of the cohort's non-NULL CD_10 values <= this value (ties inclusive); in (0, 1], always >= CD_10_pctl, and differs from it inside CD's large tie blocks (e.g. many CD = 1 or 0). NULL when CD_10 or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_all_pctl
schema.description: Minimum-rank percentile of CD_all within its pctl_year x pctl_group cohort, among families with a non-NULL CD_all: rank() / n on ascending CD, ties share the lowest rank; in (0, 1], higher = more disruptive. NULL when CD_all or pctl_group is NULL.

schema.name: CD_all_pctl_cume
schema.description: Cumulative percentile of CD_all in the same cohort: share of the cohort's non-NULL CD_all values <= this value (ties inclusive); in (0, 1], always >= CD_all_pctl, and differs from it inside CD's large tie blocks (e.g. many CD = 1 or 0). NULL when CD_all or pctl_group is NULL.

files.grain: One application in the citation graph with CD, F / E / G and ni / nj / nk per window, plus CD percentiles within filing year x CPC Section.
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id, integer); a focal family with at least one citer in the de-duplicated graph. One row per (family, year) in which ni_new, nj_new or nk_new is non-zero; years without a change have no row.

schema.name: priority_year
schema.description: Clock year of the focal family: the family's earliest priority year (min over its universe members of tls201.earliest_filing_year, the filing year where that is 9999). A few precede 1900 (min 1819) because the 1900 floor applies to filing years only.

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: Calendar priority year of this row = priority_year + yrs_since_priority; the year in which the new citers / co-citers counted in *_new appeared (up to 2023).

schema.name: yrs_since_priority
schema.description: Years since the focal family's priority year (>= 0); the row at age w (or the last row before it) carries the window-w values of patstat_disruption.

schema.name: ni_new
schema.description: Citers of the focal whose priority year is exactly this year and that cite none of its references.

schema.name: nj_new
schema.description: Citers of the focal whose priority year is exactly this year and that also cite at least one of its references.

schema.name: nk_new
schema.description: Families of exactly this year that cite at least one of the focal's references but not the focal (focal excluded).

schema.name: ni
schema.description: Cumulative ni from age 0 through this row's age; at age w it equals ni_w of patstat_disruption and the last row equals ni_all (checked on every focal family).

schema.name: nj
schema.description: Cumulative nj from age 0 through this row's age (equals nj_w of patstat_disruption at age w).

schema.name: nk
schema.description: Cumulative nk from age 0 through this row's age (equals nk_w of patstat_disruption at age w).

schema.name: CD
schema.description: Disruption index (ni - nj) / (ni + nj + nk) on the cumulative counts, i.e. CD with a window of exactly this age; in [-1, 1], never NaN on a written row.

schema.name: F
schema.description: Share of the citers that have arrived by this age classed Foundation at this age (down > up, with down counted among citers of age <= this age; up = down > 0 ties count half). NaN (a float NaN, not NULL) on rows before the first citer arrives. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E
schema.description: Share of the citers arrived by this age classed Extension (up > down, plus half of the ties); NaN before the first citer. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G
schema.description: Share of the citers arrived by this age classed Generalization (up = down = 0); NaN before the first citer. F + E + G = 1 when defined. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

files.grain: One application per year with new and cumulative ni / nj / nk, CD and F / E / G.
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: priority_year
schema.description: Cohort year of the focal documents: the family's earliest priority year (min over its universe members of tls201.earliest_filing_year, the filing year where that is 9999). A few precede 1900 (min 1819) because the 1900 floor applies to filing years only.

schema.name: yrs_since_priority
schema.description: Years since the cohort's priority year (>= 0).

schema.name: n_CD
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (priority_year, yrs_since_priority) cell with a finite CD. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal family gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those families, not every cohort member.

schema.name: CD_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative CD over the n_CD trend rows of this (priority_year, yrs_since_priority) cell (only families with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others).

schema.name: n_F
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (priority_year, yrs_since_priority) cell with a finite F. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal family gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those families, not every cohort member.

schema.name: F_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative F (Foundation share) over the n_F trend rows of this (priority_year, yrs_since_priority) cell (only families with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_F = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: n_E
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (priority_year, yrs_since_priority) cell with a finite E. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal family gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those families, not every cohort member.

schema.name: E_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative E (Extension share) over the n_E trend rows of this (priority_year, yrs_since_priority) cell (only families with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_E = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: n_G
schema.description: Number of patstat_disruption_trend rows in this (priority_year, yrs_since_priority) cell with a finite G. Trend rows exist only for years in which a focal family gained a new citer or co-citer, so this counts those families, not every cohort member.

schema.name: G_mean
schema.description: Mean cumulative G (Generalization share) over the n_G trend rows of this (priority_year, yrs_since_priority) cell (only families with a change in exactly this year; values are not carried forward for the others). NULL when n_G = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

files.grain: One (cohort year, years since) cell with mean cumulative CD / F / E / G.
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: year
schema.description: Cohort year: the family's earliest priority year, restricted to 1900-2023 (pre-1900 priority cohorts are left out).

schema.name: n
schema.description: Number of families of this cohort in patstat_disruption with a non-NULL CD_all, i.e. with at least one citer: the denominator of the `_all` means. The 3-, 5- and 10-year ni / nj / nk / njfrac means are taken over the subset with something in that window.

schema.name: CD_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of CD_3 (window 3) over the cohort's families with a non-NULL CD_3 (NULLs ignored); NULL if none.

schema.name: F_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Foundation share F_3 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Extension share E_3 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3_mean
schema.description: Mean Generalization share G_3 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of ni_3 (citers that cite none of its references) over the cohort's families with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nj_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of nj_3 (citers that also cite at least one of its references) over the cohort's families with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nk_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of nk_3 (documents citing its references but not it) over the cohort's families with something in the 3-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: njfrac_3_mean
schema.description: Mean of the per-family nj_3 / (ni_3 + nj_3 + nk_3), the share of the 3-year neighbourhood that cites both the family and its references, over the families with something in the window (the -1 placeholder is read as NULL); NULL when there are none. Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows entered as (-1)/(-3) = 1/3 and pulled the mean toward 0.333.

schema.name: CD_5_mean
schema.description: Mean of CD_5 (window 5) over the cohort's families with a non-NULL CD_5 (NULLs ignored); NULL if none.

schema.name: F_5_mean
schema.description: Mean Foundation share F_5 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_5_mean
schema.description: Mean Extension share E_5 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_5_mean
schema.description: Mean Generalization share G_5 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_5_mean
schema.description: Mean of ni_5 (citers that cite none of its references) over the cohort's families with something in the 5-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nj_5_mean
schema.description: Mean of nj_5 (citers that also cite at least one of its references) over the cohort's families with something in the 5-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nk_5_mean
schema.description: Mean of nk_5 (documents citing its references but not it) over the cohort's families with something in the 5-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: njfrac_5_mean
schema.description: Mean of the per-family nj_5 / (ni_5 + nj_5 + nk_5), the share of the 5-year neighbourhood that cites both the family and its references, over the families with something in the window (the -1 placeholder is read as NULL); NULL when there are none. Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows entered as (-1)/(-3) = 1/3 and pulled the mean toward 0.333.

schema.name: CD_10_mean
schema.description: Mean of CD_10 (window 10) over the cohort's families with a non-NULL CD_10 (NULLs ignored); NULL if none.

schema.name: F_10_mean
schema.description: Mean Foundation share F_10 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_10_mean
schema.description: Mean Extension share E_10 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_10_mean
schema.description: Mean Generalization share G_10 over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_10_mean
schema.description: Mean of ni_10 (citers that cite none of its references) over the cohort's families with something in the 10-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nj_10_mean
schema.description: Mean of nj_10 (citers that also cite at least one of its references) over the cohort's families with something in the 10-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: nk_10_mean
schema.description: Mean of nk_10 (documents citing its references but not it) over the cohort's families with something in the 10-year window: the -1 placeholder of a family with nothing in it (no citer and nothing citing its references) is read as NULL. NULL when no family of the cohort has anything in the window (the earliest cohorts). Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows were averaged in, which made this negative for early cohorts.

schema.name: njfrac_10_mean
schema.description: Mean of the per-family nj_10 / (ni_10 + nj_10 + nk_10), the share of the 10-year neighbourhood that cites both the family and its references, over the families with something in the window (the -1 placeholder is read as NULL); NULL when there are none. Before 2026-10-03 the -1 rows entered as (-1)/(-3) = 1/3 and pulled the mean toward 0.333.

schema.name: CD_all_mean
schema.description: Mean of CD_all (any age) over the cohort's families with a non-NULL CD_all (NULLs ignored); NULL if none.

schema.name: F_all_mean
schema.description: Mean Foundation share F_all over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_all_mean
schema.description: Mean Extension share E_all over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_all_mean
schema.description: Mean Generalization share G_all over the cohort's families with at least one citer in the window (NULLs ignored); NULL if none. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_all_mean
schema.description: Mean of ni_all over the n families of the cohort (all have ni/nj/nk_all >= 0).

schema.name: nj_all_mean
schema.description: Mean of nj_all over the n families of the cohort (all have ni/nj/nk_all >= 0).

schema.name: nk_all_mean
schema.description: Mean of nk_all over the n families of the cohort (all have ni/nj/nk_all >= 0).

schema.name: njfrac_all_mean
schema.description: Mean over the n families of nj_all / (ni_all + nj_all + nk_all), the share of type-j (co-citing) documents.

files.grain: One application with a WIPO sector: citation percentiles within sector x cohort year.
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id, integer); one row per family with at least one inventor row in tls207. Read from the family's representative member (patstat_metadata.inv_appln_id), not unioned over members.

schema.name: inventor_list
schema.description: Inventor PATSTAT person_ids as a ';'-joined string in invt_seq_nr order (ties by person_id): a named person once at its lowest sequence, an unnamed placeholder record (empty tls206.person_name, e.g. person_id 263) once per slot, so its id can repeat. Person records, not disambiguated inventors; identical to patstat_metadata.inventor_list. Read from the family's representative member (patstat_metadata.inv_appln_id), not unioned over members.

schema.name: n_inventors
schema.description: Number of inventor slots = length of inventor_list (distinct named persons plus each slot of an unnamed placeholder); team size under its PatentView name. Not tls201.nb_inventors.

schema.name: first_inventor
schema.description: person_id (int64) of the inventor at the lowest sequence position.

schema.name: last_inventor
schema.description: person_id (int64) of the inventor at the highest sequence position (equals first_inventor for a single inventor).

files.grain: One application with inventors: the person_id list in sequence order, its length, first and last (person records, not disambiguated inventors).
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id, integer); one row per family with at least one inventor row (same rows as patstat_inventor). Persons of the representative member inv_appln_id only.

schema.name: n_inventors
schema.description: Inventor slots under the once-per-named-person / once-per-placeholder-slot rule; identical to patstat_inventor.n_inventors.

schema.name: n_located
schema.description: Inventor slots whose person record has a two-letter country code (tls206.person_ctry_code matching [A-Z]{2}; malformed codes read as unknown); <= n_inventors.

schema.name: countries
schema.description: Distinct inventor country codes, sorted alphabetically, ';'-joined (e.g. 'AU;GB;US'); NULL if no inventor is located. Codes are the address country recorded on that application's person record.

schema.name: n_countries
schema.description: Number of codes in countries; 0 when countries is NULL.

schema.name: country_inventor_counts
schema.description: Inventors per country as 'CC:n' pairs joined by ';', ordered by count descending then code (e.g. 'GB:4;AU:1;US:1'); counts sum to n_located; NULL if none located.

schema.name: first_inventor_country
schema.description: Country of the lowest-sequence inventor; NULL when that inventor has no country (not replaced by the next located inventor).

schema.name: is_international
schema.description: TRUE when n_countries > 1 (inventors in at least two countries).

schema.name: applicant_countries
schema.description: Distinct two-letter country codes of the applicants (all tls207 rows with applt_seq_nr > 0), sorted, ';'-joined; NULL if no applicant is located; identical to patstat_metadata.applicant_ctry_list. Persons of the representative member inv_appln_id only.

files.grain: One application with inventors: the ISO2 countries of its inventors and applicants.
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id; applications sharing exactly the same priorities). One row per family with at least one application in the filing-clock universe; the key of every table in this set.

schema.name: priority_year
schema.description: Family's earliest priority year: min over its universe members of tls201.earliest_filing_year (the filing year where that is 9999); the clock year of every metric in this set. Can precede 1900 (min 1819) because the 1900 floor applies to filing years only.

schema.name: filing_year
schema.description: Filing year of the earliest-filed universe member (min tls201.appln_filing_year, 1900-2023); used as pctl_year for the CD percentiles.

schema.name: n_appln
schema.description: Number of the family's applications inside the universe (patents of invention, real applications, filed 1900-2023); at most docdb_family_size.

schema.name: offices
schema.description: Distinct filing offices (appln_auth, two-letter codes such as EP, US, WO) of the universe members, sorted, ';'-joined.

schema.name: first_appln_id
schema.description: appln_id of the earliest-filed universe member (earliest filing year, then lowest appln_id).

schema.name: appln_auth
schema.description: Filing office (two-letter appln_auth) of first_appln_id.

schema.name: granted
schema.description: TRUE if any universe member carries PATSTAT's granted flag (tls201.granted = 'Y': a first-grant publication or an IP-right-grant legal event).

schema.name: n_granted
schema.description: Number of universe members with PATSTAT's granted flag.

schema.name: grant_year
schema.description: Earliest grant year among the universe members (year of a member's first publication flagged publn_first_grant = 'Y'); NULL when no member has one, which can happen while granted is TRUE (grant known only from a legal event).

schema.name: docdb_family_size
schema.description: PATSTAT's size of the DOCDB family (tls201.docdb_family_size; max over members of this family-level value), counting all members, including those outside this universe.

schema.name: nb_citing_docdb_fam
schema.description: PATSTAT's own family-level forward-citation count (tls201.nb_citing_docdb_fam, max over members): distinct DOCDB families citing any publication or application of the family, taken as-is from PATSTAT (no window, universe or provenance filter from this pipeline); not the same as C / uniqueC here.

schema.name: ipc_main
schema.description: Main IPC symbol (tls209 ipc_position = 'F', whitespace removed, e.g. 'C07D499/06') of the earliest-filed universe member that has one (filing year, then appln_id; chosen per column); NULL if no member has one.

schema.name: cpc_code
schema.description: Representative CPC symbol (whitespace removed) of the earliest-filed universe member that has one (filing year, then appln_id; chosen per column); per member it is the alphabetically first symbol in the IPC-main subclass, else the alphabetically first symbol. NULL if no member has CPC.

schema.name: techn_field_nr
schema.description: WIPO technology field 1-35 (Schmoch concordance, tls230 field with the largest weight, ties to the lowest number) of the earliest-filed universe member that has one (filing year, then appln_id; chosen per column); NULL if none. Field names in ps_common.WIPO_FIELD.

schema.name: wipo_sector
schema.description: WIPO sector of techn_field_nr (same member): Electrical engineering (fields 1-8), Instruments (9-13), Chemistry (14-24), Mechanical engineering (25-32), Other fields (33-35); NULL with techn_field_nr. The hit-probability cohort sector.

schema.name: inv_appln_id
schema.description: appln_id of the representative member whose persons fill inventor_list, applicant_list, both country lists and applicant_sector here and in patstat_inventor / patstat_inventor_country: most located inventors, then most inventors, then earliest filing year, then lowest appln_id. Never NULL.

schema.name: ref_count
schema.description: Number of distinct cited families among this family's rows of the family patstat_reference (within-family citations excluded, any age, so later-priority references count too); 0 if none.

schema.name: npl_ref_count
schema.description: Distinct non-patent-literature documents (tls212.cited_npl_publn_id <> '0') cited by any publication of any universe member, replenished rows excluded (third-party NPL not removed); 0 if none.

schema.name: cpc_subclass_list
schema.description: Union of the members' distinct 4-character CPC subclasses, sorted, ';'-joined (e.g. 'B60G;F16C'); the atypicality input; NULL if no member has CPC.

schema.name: inventor_list
schema.description: Inventor PATSTAT person_ids (tls207 rows with invt_seq_nr > 0) as a ';'-joined string in invt_seq_nr order (ties by person_id): a named person once at its lowest sequence, an unnamed placeholder record (empty tls206.person_name) once per slot, so its id can repeat. person_ids are per-record, not disambiguated inventors; NULL if no inventor. Taken from the representative member inv_appln_id only (person_ids differ between offices, so members are not unioned).

schema.name: applicant_list
schema.description: Applicant PATSTAT person_ids (tls207 rows with applt_seq_nr > 0), ';'-joined in applt_seq_nr order with the same once-per-named-person rule; person and company records, not disambiguated; NULL if no applicant. Taken from the representative member inv_appln_id only (person_ids differ between offices, so members are not unioned).

schema.name: inventor_ctry_list
schema.description: Distinct two-letter country codes of the inventors (tls206.person_ctry_code of each person record; only [A-Z]{2} codes count, malformed ones are read as unknown), sorted, ';'-joined; NULL if no inventor has one (common for CN and JP filings). Taken from the representative member inv_appln_id only (person_ids differ between offices, so members are not unioned).

schema.name: applicant_ctry_list
schema.description: Distinct two-letter country codes of the applicants (tls206.person_ctry_code, [A-Z]{2} only), sorted, ';'-joined; NULL if none. Taken from the representative member inv_appln_id only (person_ids differ between offices, so members are not unioned).

schema.name: applicant_sector
schema.description: PATSTAT standardised-name sector (tls206.psn_sector) of the applicant at sequence number 1: COMPANY, INDIVIDUAL, UNIVERSITY, GOV NON-PROFIT, HOSPITAL, UNKNOWN or a space-joined combination (e.g. 'GOV NON-PROFIT UNIVERSITY'); NULL if missing or blank. schema.name: cited_id
schema.description: docdb_family_id of the cited family; never equal to citing_id (citations inside a family are dropped).

schema.description: Earliest priority year of the cited family.

schema.name: age
schema.description: citing_year - cited_year in years; negative for about 1.3 % of rows. Kept here; every metric requires age >= 0 (ps.EDGE_WHERE).

schema.name: citing_publn_year
schema.description: Earliest publication year among the citing publications of the application-level rows collapsed into this row (a publication-based alternative clock); 9999 = date unknown in PATSTAT.

schema.name: bucket
schema.description: Provenance bucket shared by the collapsed application rows: 'examiner' (citn_origin SEA, ISR, SUP, PRS, EXA, FOP, CH2), 'applicant' (APP) or 'other' (OPP, APL, blank). A family pair cited under several buckets has one row per bucket.

schema.name: replenished
schema.description: Always FALSE: replenished application rows are dropped before the family edges are built; kept so ps.EDGE_WHERE works unchanged.

schema.name: n_appln_edges
schema.description: Number of application-level citation rows (non-replenished rows of PATSTAT/output/patstat_reference, any application-level age) collapsed into this (citing family, cited family, bucket) row.

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id, integer); a cited family with at least one counted citation (same rows as patstat_citation).

schema.name: SB_B
schema.description: Ke et al. (2015) beauty coefficient from the yearly histogram of family citation rows (one per citing family and bucket) by age 0 .. last cited age (age >= 0, not replenished): sum over t <= t_m of (line from (0, c_0) to the peak (t_m, c_m) minus c_t) / max(c_t, 1). 0 when the first maximum is at age 0 (also the value for a single-year histogram); can be negative (min about -5); float32.

schema.name: SB_T
schema.description: Awakening time: the age t <= t_m (years since the family's priority year) at which the histogram lies farthest from the line joining (0, c_0) and the peak; 0 when the peak is at age 0.

schema.name: n_cite
schema.description: Total family citation rows (one per citing family and bucket) in the histogram, i.e. C_all of patstat_citation.

schema.name: priority_year
schema.description: Clock year of the cited family: the family's earliest priority year (min over its universe members of tls201.earliest_filing_year, the filing year where that is 9999). A few precede 1900 (min 1819) because the 1900 floor applies to filing years only.

schema.name: cite_year
schema.description: priority_year + yrs_since_priority: the priority year of the citing DOCDB families counted in this row.

schema.name: yrs_since_priority
schema.description: Lag in years from the cited family's priority year to the citer's (the minimum over the pair's edges, which is the only lag because both ends have one clock year each); >= 0.

schema.name: uniqueC
schema.description: Number of distinct citing DOCDB families whose citation of this family falls at this lag. Cumulative sums over lags <= 3/5/10/all reproduce uniqueC_3/5/10/all of patstat_citation, and the column equals patstat_citation_trend.uniqueC row for row (both asserted in the notebook).

schema.name: docdb_family_id
schema.description: DOCDB simple-family id (tls201.docdb_family_id, integer); a family with at least two distinct CPC subclasses (the union of its universe members' CPC subclasses).

schema.name: Z_median
schema.description: Median over the family's subclass pairs of the pair z-score (Kim et al. (2016) hypergeometric z of a CPC-subclass pair in the family's priority year, with counts cumulative over all families with >= 2 subclasses up to and including that year; z < 0 = atypical pair).

schema.name: Z_10pct
schema.description: 10th percentile (linear interpolation, DuckDB quantile_cont) of the family's pair z-scores; low values flag atypical combinations.

schema.name: Z_min
schema.description: Minimum pair z-score of the family (its most atypical subclass pair).

schema.name: n_pairs
schema.description: Number of distinct CPC-subclass pairs scored = k(k-1)/2 for k distinct subclasses.

files.grain: One application with at least two CPC subclasses: atypicality z summaries.
files.note: Family unit: one row per DOCDB family (key docdb_family_id), earliest priority year at both ends, distinct family-to-family citations; read 'application' in the row meaning as 'family'.

schema.name: code_1
schema.description: First CPC subclass of the pair (4 characters, e.g. 'A01B'); always alphabetically lower than code_2.

schema.name: code_2
schema.description: Second CPC subclass of the pair (4 characters); alphabetically higher than code_1.

schema.name: year
schema.description: Year in which at least one family with >= 2 subclasses carries this pair, on this set's clock: the family's earliest priority year (min over its universe members of tls201.earliest_filing_year, the filing year where that is 9999). A few precede 1900 (min 1819) because the 1900 floor applies to filing years only.

schema.name: Z_score
schema.description: Hypergeometric z = (o - mu) / sqrt(var) with mu = n_a n_b / N and var = mu (1 - n_a / N) (N - n_b) / (N - 1), where N, n_a, n_b and o (co-occurrences) count families with >= 2 subclasses cumulatively through this year inclusive; 0 when var <= 0. z < 0 = rarer than chance (atypical).

schema.name: pctl_c3
schema.description: Percentile of the paper's patent-citation count C_3 (pcs_citation) within its (FoS, year) cohort, on a 0-1 scale: pandas rank(method='min', pct=True) = (1 + number of cohort papers with a strictly lower C_3) / cohort size, so values lie in (0, 1] and ties share the lowest rank. schema.name: case_id
schema.description: Caselaw Access Project (CAP) integer case id (metadata.csv `id`; values 1-12,707,012, 5,179,698 cases exist). One row per case.

schema.name: CD_3
schema.description: CD disruption index (ni - nj) / (ni + nj + nk) over cases decided 0 to 3 years after the focal case (0 <= y - y_F <= 3); -1 consolidating to +1 disruptive. Null when the case is never cited at all, or when the window holds neither a citer nor an nk case; if the window has no citer but nk > 0 it is exactly 0 (not 'balanced').

schema.name: F_3
schema.description: Foundation share (0-1) of the in-window citers c with e_i > e_j, ties e_i = e_j > 0 counted half; e_j = number of the focal case's references c also cites, e_i = number of the focal case's in-window citers c also cites. F + E + G = 1; null when the case has no citer in the window (C_3 = 0). Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: E_3
schema.description: Extension share (0-1) of the in-window citers with e_j > e_i (cites more of the focal case's references than of its citers), ties e_i = e_j > 0 counted half; null when C_3 = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: G_3
schema.description: Generalization share (0-1) of the in-window citers with e_i = e_j = 0 (cites neither the focal case's references nor its other citers); null when C_3 = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_3
schema.description: Count (stored as float) of cases decided 0 to 3 years after the focal case (0 <= y - y_F <= 3) that cite the focal case but none of its references. ni + nj equals case_citation.C_3; null exactly where CD_3 is null.

schema.name: nj_3
schema.description: Count (float) of cases decided 0 to 3 years after the focal case (0 <= y - y_F <= 3) that cite the focal case and at least one of its references; null where CD_3 is null.

schema.name: nk_3

schema.description: Generalization share (0-1) of the in-window citers with e_i = e_j = 0 (cites neither the focal case's references nor its other citers); null when C_10 = 0. Decomposition of Fang & Evans (2025), arXiv:2510.03240.

schema.name: ni_10
schema.description: Count (stored as float) of cases decided 0 to 10 years after the focal case (0 <= y - y_F <= 10) that cite the focal case but none of its references. ni + nj equals case_citation.C_10; null exactly where CD_10 is null.

schema.name: nj_10
schema.description: Count (float) of cases decided 0 to 10 years after the focal case (0 <= y - y_F <= 10) that cite the focal case and at least one of its references; null where CD_10 is null.

schema.name: nk_10
schema.description: Count (float) of cases decided 0 to 10 years after the focal case (0 <= y - y_F <= 10) that cite at least one of the focal case's references but not the focal case; null where CD_10 is null.

schema.name: CD_all
schema.description: CD disruption index (ni - nj) / (ni + nj + nk) over cases decided at or after the focal case (0 <= y - y_F); -1 consolidating to +1 disruptive. Null when the case is never cited at all, or when the window holds neither a citer nor an nk case; if the window has no citer but nk > 0 it is exactly 0 (not 'balanced').

schema.name: F_all
schema.description: Foundation share (0-1) of the in-window citers c with e_i > e_j, ties e_i = e_j > 0 counted half; e_j = number of the focal case's references c also cites, e_i = number of the focal case's in-window citers c also cites. schema.name: case_id
schema.description: Caselaw Access Project (CAP) integer case id (metadata.csv `id`; values 1-12,707,012, 5,179,698 cases exist). Only cases with at least one dated citation appear (3,787,861).

schema.name: SB_B
schema.description: Ke et al. (2015) beauty coefficient B from the yearly citation counts c_t at age t = citing decision year - decision year (t >= 0): sum over t = 0..t_m of the gap between the straight line from (0, c_0) to the first peak (t_m, c_m) and c_t, divided by max(c_t, 1). Unitless; 0 when the peak is in the decision year, and it can be negative.

schema.name: SB_T
schema.description: Awakening time in years since decision: the age t in [0, t_m] whose (t, c_t) lies farthest from the line joining (0, c_0) and the peak (t_m, c_m); 0 when the peak is at age 0.

schema.name: n_cite
schema.description: Number of dated citations the curve was built from (all citing cases with lag >= 0, equal to case_citation.C_all). B is noisy for small n_cite, so filter on it.
